news.Title: 2 Fintech Stocks to Buy After They Raised Their 2026 Forecasts in October
news.Content:
SoFi Technologies (NASDAQ: SOFI) and PayPal Holdings (NASDAQ: PYPL) both raised their 2026 outlooks on Oct. 27, signaling renewed confidence in their growth prospects. But which stock has the better growth potential and makes the stronger case for buying the stock?

Let's start with the company adding customers at a record pace.

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

An all-in-one financial app is driving SoFi's member growth

SoFi has been steadily building an all-in-one online financial services platform, and that strategy is starting to pay off.

Its third-quarter results showed strong growth in both its customer base and the number of products those customers use. The company added a record 1.2 million customers during the quarter, bringing its total to 17.1 million.

Customers are also using multiple products, giving the company more opportunities to generate revenue from each relationship. Its financial services business is expanding through products like SoFi Money, Invest, Relay, and its credit card offerings.

As a result, SoFi raised its 2026 outlook, increasing its adjusted net revenue forecast to about $5 billion and reaffirming its adjusted earnings-per-share (EPS) forecast of $0.61. More importantly, management also announced its 2027 outlook, targeting $0.90 in adjusted EPS, meaning not in accordance with generally accepted accounting principles (GAAP).

But the company still faces risks, as SoFi remains exposed to consumer credit conditions, loan defaults, and interest rate changes. Its ambitious strategy also requires significant investment, while competition could make customer acquisition more difficult.

Still, analysts see room for gains, with an average target price of $20.80, representing about 25% potential upside. Today, the stock trades at a forward price-to-earnings (P/E) ratio of about 19.6, which is a relatively reasonable valuation for a fintech company with solid growth ambitions. If management delivers on its earnings targets, the stock could offer plenty of gains.

Meanwhile, another fintech giant is taking a different approach to accelerate growth.

A global network and Venmo give PayPal room to grow

PayPal's biggest advantage is its established global network of consumers and merchants. Its branded checkout service remains widely recognized, while Venmo offers another avenue for growth, especially among younger consumers. The company is also expanding its presence in buy now, pay later (BNPL), mobile payments, and merchant services.

Story Continues

These days, results show that some of these initiatives are gaining traction. Venmo, for example, continues to deliver strong transaction growth, with increasing adoption of its debit card and Pay with Venmo features. Plus, Braintree, PayPal's unbranded payment processing business, is benefiting from growing transaction volumes as more merchants use the platform.

As a result, PayPal raised its 2026 non-GAAP EPS outlook to about $5.60, up from its previous forecast of roughly $5.38. This suggests that management is becoming more confident in its cost-efficiency initiatives and its ability to generate profitable growth. The company also expects to generate at least $6.5 billion in adjusted free cash flow (FCF) for the year, supporting its ongoing investment and shareholder return plans.

However, PayPal still faces challenges, as its branded checkout business is intensely competitive with Apple Pay, Google Pay, and other payment providers. Revenue growth also remains relatively modest, while the company needs to prove that its operational improvements can drive stronger top-line growth.

For now, the majority of analysts rate the stock a hold, with an average target price of $57.10, which implies only about 5% upside. It also trades at a forward P/E of just 9.7 times, as investors weigh the risks of its turnaround.

With SoFi and PayPal raising their outlooks, the question now is which stock offers the more compelling opportunity for investors.

Which fintech stock is the stronger buy?

Both SoFi and PayPal gave investors reasons to be optimistic after raising their 2026 forecasts. However, SoFi has a stronger growth case thanks to its expanding financial ecosystem, rising customer adoption, and ambitious earnings outlook for 2027. PayPal offers a potentially attractive turnaround opportunity, but it still needs to prove that its various initiatives can accelerate growth.

For growth-focused investors, SoFi is the higher-risk, higher-reward pick. PayPal is the safer option for value seekers, thanks to its low valuation. Both could appeal to buyers at current valuations, given the upward revisions to their outlooks.

news.Title: Better Foundry Stock: Taiwan Semiconductor vs. Intel
news.Content:
Today, most companies that develop logic chips, like graphics processing units (GPUs) and central processing units (CPUs), use what is known as a fabless model. This simply means that they outsource the manufacturing of their chips to a third party. Two of the largest foundries in the world today are Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing (NYSE: TSM) and Intel (NASDAQ: INTC), and the better foundry stock to own, in my view, is an easy choice: it's TSMC by a wide margin.

Chip manufacturing is a capex -heavy, complex business. That is why so many chipmakers use third-party foundries. There is a constant push in the semiconductor industry to densify chips to make them more powerful and energy-efficient. This requires both expensive extreme ultraviolet (EUV) lithography equipment and technological expertise to achieve high yields.

Missed AI's "Act 1"? Act 2 Could Be 16x Bigger. Most investors think they missed the AI boat because they didn't buy Nvidia in 2005. But according to our analysts, we're only at the end of "Act 1"—the R&D phase. "Act 2" is the global rollout. Continue »

At the same time, the chip manufacturing business requires both high utilization and scale. Fabs (chip manufacturing facilities) need to be running near full capacity to be profitable and attain good margins. Meanwhile, fixed costs need to be spread out across a large manufacturing base. This all gives a clear edge to TSMC.

TSMC: The foundry leader

Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing is the largest foundry in the world and the one that has enjoyed the most success. Its expertise in manufacturing advanced logic chips is second to none, and it has been able to shrink node sizes (increase density) and achieve high yields (few defects) better than rivals Intel and Samsung . This has given TSMC a near monopoly on advanced chip manufacturing.

The company's scale is also unmatched, with fabs in Taiwan, Japan, and the U.S., and it is aggressively ramping up its own capex to increase capacity to meet the growing needs of its customers. Importantly, it is also a leader in advanced packaging, which allows it to integrate AI processors and high bandwidth memory (HBM) into a single package, improving data-transfer speeds and overall computing performance.

TSMC's position in the market has made it an integral part of the semiconductor supply chain and a close partner to chip designers like Nvidia , Broadcom , and Advanced Micro Devices . It has also given TSMC strong pricing power, which has helped it steadily improve its gross margins .

Story Continues

Intel: Playing catch-up

Intel is one of the few companies that does much of its chip manufacturing internally, although it also uses TSMC for certain chip designs and components. Meanwhile, Intel has aggressively expanded its fab footprint in an attempt to offer third-party manufacturing services. However, this strategy does have some drawbacks.

The biggest is that Intel is not an independent third-party foundry. Because it designs and makes its own chips, there are issues with customer trust and with other chip companies having to turn over important IP (intellectual property). In addition, the company has struggled to achieve the high yields that could attract customers to its platform.

To top it off, Intel has spent a massive amount on capex to build new fabs while playing catch-up to TSMC and needing high utilization rates to reach profitability. It hasn't been able to achieve these necessary utilization rates, and its foundry segment has been a major drag on its operations.

While Intel has recently seen some momentum in its data center chip business, largely due to the rise of agentic AI and the need for more CPUs, the company's stock took a major hit when it issued weaker-than-expected guidance due to the struggling PC market. Meanwhile, the company's server CPU business, while a growth driver, is expected to continue to lose share to AMD, ARM Holdings , and ARM-based custom chips in the coming years.

TSMC is the better buy

TSMC is both the better company and the cheaper stock. It trades at a forward P/E of around 17 times 2027 analyst estimates compared to 32 times for Intel. While Intel does have the opportunity to leverage its foundry business and help it become a growth driver, whether this will happen is still a big unknown.

TSM PE Ratio (Forward 1y) data by YCharts

As such, I'd stick with TSMC as the foundry stock to buy.

news.Title: 4 Reasons I Won't Be Touching the Anthropic IPO With a 10-Foot Pole
news.Content: Roughly five months ago, on June 12, Elon Musk's Space Exploration Technologies (NASDAQ:SPCX) shattered Wall Street's record books with the largest initial public offering (IPO) in history . In a matter of weeks, the developer of the Claude large language model (LLM), Anthropic (Nasdaq: ANT), may boot SpaceX from the pedestal it claimed. On Oct. 26, Anthropic filed its long-awaited public prospectus (S-1), providing investors with hundreds of pages concerning its operating performance, balance sheet, and risk factors. It also started the clock on its public debut, which is expected before the Thanksgiving Day holiday. Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue » Image source: Getty Images. While the table is set for Anthropic to be the most-hyped IPO in Wall Street's storied history, I have four predominantly history-backed reasons why I won't be touching it with a 10-foot pole . Hot tech IPOs often struggle Though no one denies what a game changer Claude has been among LLMs, more than 14 years of history show that tech-focused IPOs commonly face-plant after their debuts. According to Truist Financial (NYSE:TFC), which examined the time-based performance of 30 of the most hyped tech-centric IPOs since May 2012 (not including SpaceX), just 43% were higher after one year. More importantly, the average year-one maximum drawdown for these IPOs is 55%. In other words, the retail investor hype that often launched these stocks out of the starting gate quickly faded. The valuation doesn't make sense Secondly, Anthropic will likely be priced for perfection, assuming a market value of $1.5 trillion to $2 trillion. Over the trailing 12 months (TTM), Anthropic generated about $19.7 billion in sales, putting it on track to sport a TTM price-to-sales (P/S) ratio of between 76 and 102. History tells us that a TTM P/S ratio above 30 has consistently been indicative of a bubble. It's the arbitrary line in the sand that frequently marked a top for internet stocks in the late 1990s and early 2000s. No matter how the numbers are approached, Anthropic's valuation appears far too aggressive. Game-changing technology bubbles have always burst Building on the previous point, no game-changing technological innovation since (and including) the advent and proliferation of the internet in the mid-1990s has avoided an early-stage bubble-bursting event. Story Continues Bubbles continue to form and subsequently burst around hyped innovations because of the overzealousness of retail investors. For over three decades, they've been overestimating the pace of adoption and/or optimization of new technologies, including the internet, 3D printing, blockchain technology, and the metaverse. While enterprise AI hardware and LLM adoption have been insatiable, optimizing AI solutions to maximize sales and profits will take several years. This leaves the door wide open for an AI bubble-bursting event. Insiders can fleece retail investors Lastly, Anthropic's prospectus outlined a staggered and accelerated share lockup period that, in my view, allows insiders to completely fleece retail investors. Typically, newly public companies prevent their insiders (high-ranking executives, board members, and early investors) from selling shares for the first 180 calendar days after the IPO. This ensures that insiders don't take advantage of early retail investor hype. Anthropic's prospectus laid out 23 separate insider share-unlock events, including one on the company's debut day! We're about to witness one of the greatest wealth transfers in Wall Street's storied history, with insiders making bank and retail investors left holding the bag. Missed AI's "Act 1"? Act 2 Could Be 14x Bigger Most investors think they missed the AI boat because they didn't buy Nvidia in 2005. But according to our analysts, we're only at the end of "Act 1"—the R&D phase. "Act 2" is the global rollout, a massive technology build-out that Google's CEO says could be more profound than fire or electricity. While everyone watches the chip designers, one "backbone" company provides the critical technology that Nvidia and AMD literally cannot function without. We've detailed this under-the-radar player in our new AI Playbook. Continue » Sean Williams has no position in any of the stocks mentioned. The Motley Fool has positions in and recommends Truist Financial. news.Title: Silicon Motion Technology Corp's Dividend Analysis
news.Content:
This article first appeared on GuruFocus .

Upcoming Payout, Yield Profile and Sustainability Metrics for Value Investors

Silicon Motion Technology Corp ( NASDAQ:SIMO ) recently announced a total dividend of $0.58 per share, comprising a $0.58 per share cash dividend. The ex-dividend date is set for 2026-11-05, and the payment is scheduled to be made on 2026-11-19. Investors must own shares before the ex-dividend date to qualify for this distribution. As shareholders look forward to this upcoming payment, the spotlight also shines on the company's dividend history, yield, and growth rates. Drawing on data from GuruFocus, this analysis examines Silicon Motion Technology Corp's dividend performance and assesses its long-term sustainability for income-focused investors.

What Does Silicon Motion Technology Corp Do?

Silicon Motion Technology Corp is a fabless semiconductor company that designs NAND flash controllers and related storage solutions. Its products include embedded storage controllers for smartphones, tablets, and consumer electronics; client SSD controllers for personal computers; enterprise and data center SSD controllers; and controllers for flash cards, USB drives, and industrial and automotive embedded storage. The company also offers complete SSD solutions and firmware. It sells primarily to NAND flash makers, module manufacturers, and OEMs, generating most revenue from controller chip sales, with a smaller portion from SSD solutions. Revenue is concentrated in Asia, particularly Taiwan, China, and South Korea, alongside customers in the United States and other regions. Silicon Motion is headquartered in Hong Kong with significant operations in Taiwan, China, and the United States, and competes in the merchant controller market for solid-state storage.

A Glimpse at Silicon Motion Technology Corp's Dividend History

Silicon Motion Technology Corp has maintained a consistent dividend payment record since 2013, a span of more than a decade that speaks to management's commitment to returning capital. Dividends are currently distributed on a quarterly basis, giving income-oriented investors a predictable cadence of payments throughout the year. A long and uninterrupted record is often viewed by value investors as evidence of financial discipline, particularly in the cyclical semiconductor industry where earnings can swing sharply. The chart below shows annual Dividends Per Share , which helps track historical trends and gauge whether payouts have grown, held steady, or fluctuated over time.

Story Continues

Breaking Down Silicon Motion Technology Corp's Dividend Yield and Growth

As of today, Silicon Motion Technology Corp currently has a 12-month trailing dividend yield of 1.36% and a 12-month forward dividend yield of 1.36%. The identical trailing and forward figures suggest an expectation of the same dividend payments over the next 12 months, implying that analysts and the company do not currently anticipate a material change to the payout level. For value investors, a modest yield of this size indicates that Silicon Motion Technology Corp is not positioned as a pure income play; instead, total return is likely to depend more heavily on earnings growth and share price appreciation than on cash distributions alone.

Based on Silicon Motion Technology Corp's dividend yield and five-year growth rate, the 5-year yield on cost of Silicon Motion Technology Corp stock as of today is approximately 1.36%. Yield on cost measures the current annualized dividend divided by the original purchase price, offering long-term holders a way to track the income return on their initial investment. When the yield on cost matches the current yield, it generally signals that the dividend has grown roughly in line with the share price over the period. The chart below traces the company's dividend yield history for additional context.

The Sustainability Question: Payout Ratio and Profitability

To assess the sustainability of the dividend, one needs to evaluate the company's payout ratio. The dividend payout ratio provides insights into the portion of earnings the company distributes as dividends. A lower ratio suggests that the company retains a significant part of its earnings, thereby ensuring the availability of funds for future growth and unexpected downturns. As of 2026-09-30, Silicon Motion Technology Corp's dividend payout ratio is 0.26, meaning roughly 26% of earnings are paid out as dividends. That leaves a substantial cushion for reinvestment, debt reduction, or dividend increases, and it is generally considered a conservative level for a semiconductor business.

Silicon Motion Technology Corp's profitability rank offers an understanding of the company's earnings prowess relative to its peers. GuruFocus ranks Silicon Motion Technology Corp's profitability 8 out of 10 as of 2026-09-30, suggesting good profitability prospects. The company has reported positive net income for each year over the past decade, further solidifying its high profitability. This combination of a low payout ratio and a strong profitability rank is a favorable signal for dividend safety, though investors should remember that semiconductor earnings remain sensitive to industry cycles.

Growth Metrics: The Future Outlook

To ensure the sustainability of dividends, a company must have robust growth metrics. Silicon Motion Technology Corp's growth rank of 8 out of 10 suggests that the company's growth trajectory is good relative to its competitors. A high growth rank implies expanding operating performance, which in turn supports the capacity to fund future dividends. However, growth rankings reflect relative positioning rather than absolute momentum, so investors should pair this score with the underlying revenue and earnings trends discussed below before drawing firm conclusions about the dividend's long-term trajectory.

Revenue is the lifeblood of any company, and Silicon Motion Technology Corp's revenue per share , combined with the 3-year revenue growth rate , indicates a strong revenue model. Silicon Motion Technology Corp's revenue has increased by approximately -2.40% per year on average, a rate that underperforms approximately 60.16% of global competitors. The negative figure reflects the cyclical pressure that has weighed on NAND flash controller demand in recent periods, a factor value investors should monitor closely when judging whether the current dividend pace can be maintained.

The company's 3-year EPS growth rate showcases its capability to grow its earnings, a critical component for sustaining dividends in the long run. During the past three years, Silicon Motion Technology Corp's earnings increased by approximately -14.10% per year on average, a rate that underperforms approximately 63.43% of global competitors. Lastly, the company's 5-year EBITDA growth rate of -6.90% underperforms approximately 72.33% of global competitors. Together, these metrics suggest that near-term growth has lagged peers, even as profitability and payout coverage remain solid.

Next Steps for Dividend-Focused Investors

Silicon Motion Technology Corp's dividend profile presents a mixed but balanced picture. On the positive side, the company has paid dividends since 2013, maintains a conservative payout ratio of 0.26, earns a profitability rank of 8 out of 10, and has posted positive net income in each of the past ten years. The upcoming $0.58 per share payment, with an ex-dividend date of 2026-11-05 and a paydate of 2026-11-19, fits comfortably within that framework. On the cautionary side, a 1.36% yield offers limited income, and negative three-year revenue, EPS, and five-year EBITDA growth rates indicate cyclical headwinds that could pressure future payout growth if they persist.

For value investors, the key question is whether Silicon Motion Technology Corp's controller franchise can return to growth as data center and enterprise SSD demand evolves, and whether management will raise the dividend once earnings recover. news.Title: Meta’s Euro Bonds Jump on First Day of Trading After Record Sale
news.Content:
(Bloomberg) -- Meta Platforms Inc.'s freshly-minted euro bonds are being quoted above face value after a sale that drew record investor orders for a corporate bond in Europe.

Most Read from Bloomberg

Morgan Stanley Offers $2.3 Billion Debt for Dell Family Deal

Democrats Clinch Huge Wins on Inflation Anger, Trump Fatigue

What the Democrats' Sweep of Congress Means for Trump

Democrats Sweep to Control of Congress in Rebuke of Trump

Trump Now Has to Govern Through a Midterm Meltdown of His Own Making

All six of Meta's tranches are indicated higher on Thursday, with even bid prices — the level at which a trader is willing to buy the bond — standing above par, based on data compiled by Bloomberg. Bankers arranging the €9 billion ($10.1 billion) deal on Wednesday had priced each bond at just below 100 cents on the euro.

The price jump follows a record-breaking deal for Meta, with a €62 billion order book that dwarfed the prior €31 billion record set by Anheuser-Busch InBev NV a decade ago. Bids mounted as the spreads offered were far wider than other hyperscalers that have issued euro-denominated debt and were more in line with bonds rated several steps lower than Meta's double-A score.

Meta and other hyperscalers have been offering juicy yields in recent bond sales to entice buyers who are growing skeptical about whether massive spending on artificial intelligence will pay off. While investors piled into Meta's deal, they're becoming more selective about AI-related bonds in general, especially from highly-leveraged companies.

Euro-denominated bonds that Alphabet Inc. sold on Monday are also indicated above face value today.

news.Title: U.S. midterms fallout in focus; Qualcomm shares slip - what’s moving markets
news.Content:
Investing.com - Futures linked to the main U.S. stock indices hover around both sides of the flatline, as investors digest a major Democratic victory in the American midterm elections and begin looking ahead to the release of key employment data later in the week. Chipmakers in the U.S. and Asia retreat amid expectations that Democrats could increase regulatory scrutiny on the artificial intelligence industry, while Qualcomm shares fall on weak smartphone chip demand.

Still guessing which stocks will beat the market? Our AI portfolio updates monthly and is outperforming the S&P 500 by 118%. See this month's list »

1. Futures mixed

U.S. stock futures were mixed on Thursday. By 03:03 ET (08:03 GMT), the S&P 500 futures contract had dropped by 15 points, or 0.2%, Nasdaq 100 futures had declined by 289 points, or 1.0%, and Dow futures had increased by 169 points, or 0.3%.

The main averages on Wall Street rallied on Wednesday, with traders attempting to gauge the implications of the midterms, which will see Democrats gain control of both chambers of Congress starting in January. Some analysts suggested that political gridlock -- with Republican President Donald Trump and a Democratic Congress checking their respective agendas -- can reduce the risk of policy surprises, providing a modicum of stability for financial markets.

Meanwhile, oil prices declined on hopes that the U.S. and Iran are now more likely to find a diplomatic resolution to their war, which could improve the outlook for inflation and lessen the need for the Federal Reserve to aggressively ratchet up interest rates, analysts at Yardeni Research said in a note.

They added that megacap tech profits and free cash flow may increase if Democrats attempt to slow the rapid development of artificial intelligence, while fewer AI-related bond issues "would also help keep a lid on bond yields."

"Financial markets put a positive spin on the blue wave," the Yardeni analysts said.

2. Chipmakers decline

Yet the prospect of a decelerating AI build-out weighed on U.S. semiconductor stocks overnight, initiating a selloff that bled into chipmaker-heavy indices in South Korea and Taiwan.

AI chip giant Nvidia was slightly lower in extended-hours trading, as were peers Advanced Micro Devices and Intel.

Shares of memory-chip titans SK Hynix and Samsung Electronics in South Korea slipped sharply. In Taiwan, Foxconn Technology Group, the world's biggest contract electronics maker, slumped by more than 3%, while top contract chipmaker Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. fell by 0.88%.

Story Continues

Analysts have fretted that Democrats could use their newfound influence in Congress to pursue greater regulation of the AI industry, scrutinizing the proliferation of massive data centers, in particular.

Democrat Gina Hinojosa's election as governor of Texas, where a number of large-scale data center projects are planned, may also be a precursor to more stringent data center rules in the state, analysts at Macquarie Group said in a note.

3. Qualcomm slumps on weak smartphone chip sales

Unsure what to buy ahead of earnings? Our AI's recent pre-earnings calls delivered gains of +77% to +118% after results dropped. See this month's earnings picks »

Elsewhere, shares of Qualcomm tumbled by more than 8% in after-hours trading, as an upbeat forecast for the chipmaker's data-center unit was offset by underwhelming sales of its smartphone chips.

Revenue from the handset chip division sank by 26% to $5.14 billion in the fourth quarter, missing expectations of $5.25 billion, according to Visible Alpha projections cited by Reuters.

Data from Counterpoint Research has shown that global smartphone shipments fell by a fifth in the September quarter -- dented in part by the AI data center build-out, which has caused a surge in memory-chip costs that have pushed up phone prices.

Qualcomm CEO Cristiano Amon flagged in an interview with Reuters that Android handset sales had bottomed out, but were beginning to edge back up again.

4. Brent hovers around $95 a barrel

Oil prices largely steadied just above $95 a barrel on Thursday, after plunging more than 8% in the previous session, as investors considered the possibility that the Democrats' sweeping victory could raise pressure on Trump to end the war with Iran.

Brent crude futures settled down $8.98, or 8.7%, at $94.62 a barrel on Wednesday, while U.S. West Texas Intermediate (WTI) crude fell $7.97, or 8.3%, to $88.12. Both benchmarks settled at their lowest levels since August 31.

The selloff followed a slew of Democratic victories in both the House of Representatives and Senate, boosting expectations that a Democratic-controlled Congress could constrain funding for military operations and push the Trump administration towards a negotiated settlement in the Middle East.

Trump acknowledged that the war with Iran had contributed to his party's electoral defeat, while Vice President JD Vance also questioned the conflict's political and economic costs.

Investors widely interpreted the election outcome as potentially increasing the likelihood of de-escalation, which could eventually allow more oil to flow through the Strait of Hormuz, a critical shipping route for global energy supplies.

5. Bank of England decision ahead

The Bank of England is anticipated to lift interest rates on Thursday for the first time in more than three years, with policymakers aiming to corral inflationary pressures sparked by the Iran war.

Pressure on the BoE's Monetary Policy Committee to increase rates by a quarter of a percentage point has risen in recent months. Inflation in the United Kingdom has remained stubbornly elevated, accelerating to an 11-month high of 3.5% in September, reflecting a jump in energy prices caused partially by ongoing supply constraints out of the Middle East.

Given that inflation is now well above the BoE's target level of 2%, the central bank is tipped to react by increasing rates both this month and possibly more next year.

(Reuters contributed reporting)

news.Content: 針對近期台股動盪與外資動向，金管會證期局副局長黃仲豪於今（5）日主持說明會，針對媒體高度關注的10月外資淨匯出入、買賣超數據，以及台股接連重挫的因應措施做出全面回應。金管會強調，儘管台股面臨國際股市波動影響，但整體上市公司營運表現、基本面及信用風險指標皆在可控範圍內，呼籲市場理性看待。 台股大跌逾千點！金管會公布關鍵防線與市場數據 針對台股近期連日走跌、今日再度跌破千點，市場關注是否祭出救市措施（如平盤下禁放空等），黃仲豪公布多項核心數據，強調台股基本面與風險指標仍具韌性。 今日加權指數收在41,574點，下跌1,374點，跌幅為3.2%，成交量約9,260.24億元。與亞鄰主要股市相比，跌幅互有領先，例如韓國股市今日跌幅約5.52%，相對較深。 在基本面支撐方面，截至9月底，台股本益比為26.68倍，殖利率1.54%，累計前3季總營收達49.89兆元，年成長率達38.21%。此外，國發會景氣燈號連10月亮出紅燈，IMB國家競爭力排名全球第4，亞洲公司治理協會評鑑名列第3，顯示企業實質營運與總體經濟表現依然強勁。 在風險管控指標方面，整戶擔保維持率截至昨日為167.42%，距離斷頭門檻的130%仍有一段安全距離。另外，借券賣出占總市場成交值比重為4.42%，整體信用風險在可控範圍內。 10月外資動向：單月與累計賣超雙創5年同期新高 在匯出入與買賣超數據方面，黃仲豪指出，10月份台股受國際股市聯動影響，波動較大，相關數據同步出爐。 在單月買賣超部分，外資單月賣超上市公司股票達9,421.8億元，創下5年來單月第一大賣超，同時也是歷年10月份同期的單月最高紀錄。若看累計買賣超，今年截至10月底，累計賣超金額達2兆2,947億元，同樣刷新5年來同期累計賣超第一大紀錄。 在資金匯出入方面，10月單月淨匯出64.61億美元，為5年來同期（10月）第一大淨匯出，而歷史單月最高紀錄則出現在111年3月的68.9億美元。至於今年累計表現，儘管10月匯出較多，但以全年來看，累計至10月底仍呈現淨匯入1,019億美元，創下5年來同期第一大累計淨匯入。 金管會分析，外資賣超與股市高度連動，但外資賣超並不等同於資金立刻匯出，部分屬於多空運作的操作策略。雖然10月份匯出金額增加，但拉長至全年格局來看，外資整體仍為淨匯入。 澄清跨業信用調查傳言：不影響民眾資金排程

news.Title: Is Apple a Buy on the Dip, or Are Mounting Headwinds Too Strong?
news.Content:
Apple (NASDAQ: AAPL) posted another strong quarter of iPhone sales when it reported its fiscal fourth-quarter results after the bell on Nov. 2. However, the stock traded lower on worries of gross margin compression due to higher memory prices and decelerating service revenue growth.

The stock was up nearly 25% on the year before the report.

Missed AI's "Act 1"? Act 2 Could Be 16x Bigger. Most investors think they missed the AI boat because they didn't buy Nvidia in 2005. But according to our analysts, we're only at the end of "Act 1"—the R&D phase. "Act 2" is the global rollout. Continue »

Let's take a closer look at the company's fiscal Q4 results and prospects to see why I wouldn't be chasing this small pullback.

Strong iPhone sales

Apple's fiscal Q4 tends to be a seasonally weaker quarter for the company, as it comes right before the release of its newer model phone and before the holiday season. Its new iPhone 18 Pro was only available eight days in the quarter, while its new iPhone Duo didn't hit shelves until after the quarter was over. However, the company did benefit from the $100 price increase it implemented in June.

iPhone sales soared 17% to $57.58 billion, which was a September quarter record and ahead of the $56.54 billion analyst consensus, as compiled by LSEG . It saw strong double-digit iPhone sales in both the U.S. and Greater China, and set a record for upgraders worldwide. Meanwhile, it said the response to both the iPhone 18 and Duo has been strong.

Other product sales were mixed

Mac revenue was also strong, with sales climbing 24% year over year to $10.79 billion and topping analyst expectations for sales of $9.61 billion. The company credited strong growth in emerging markets. It set a September quarter record for new Mac customers.

Sales of Apple's other products were generally weak. Sales of iPads fell 10% to 6.23 billion, while wearable revenue sank by 8% to $8.3 billion. However, the company did recently launch new products in these categories, including a new iPad mini with an OLED display and Apple HomeView, which is meant to act as an entertainment and personal assistant hub.

Total product segment sales climbed by 12.5% to $82.9 billion. China was once again solid, with revenue jumping 21% to $17.54 billion.

Apple services revenue growth slows again

Apple's services segment -- which consists of its App Store, iCloud storage, Google Search revenue sharing, Apple Pay, Apple TV, and more -- saw revenue rise 10% to $31.57 billion. That was a continued deceleration from the 12% growth it saw in fiscal Q3 and 16% growth it saw in fiscal Q2. It was the segment's slowest quarterly growth since 2022.

Story Continues

Product gross margin came in at 37.2%, and excluding tariff refunds in both quarters was down 100 basis points sequentially. Like others in the space, Apple is currently dealing with surging memory prices. Service margin, meanwhile, rose by 40 basis points sequentially to 76%. Overall gross margin was 47.9%, which was above analyst expectations of 47.5%.

Overall, Apple's revenue rose by 12% to $114.48 billion, while its earnings per share (EPS) jumped 14% to $2.10. Excluding an $0.05 tariff rebate boost, adjusted EPS would have been $2.05. That topped the analyst consensus estimates for EPS of $1.99 on sales of $113.39 billion.

Tempered guidance

For fiscal Q1, Apple projected its revenue to grow by 7% to 10% year over year, impacted by currency headwinds and supply constraints. Service revenue is expected to increase between 8% to 9%, hurt by third-party licensing and currency headwinds. The company guided for gross margin to be between 45% and 46%.

Analysts were looking for revenue growth of 6%, but gross margins of 46.3%.

Time to stay on the sidelines

Apple has one of the best compounding business models in the world, but it is facing headwinds from memory prices, supply constraints, and currency headwinds. The company so far has been bucking the overall weakness in the smartphone and PC markets, but high memory prices are pressuring its gross margins. Another worry is the continued deceleration of the company's high-margin services business, which had been a consistent mid-teen revenue grower in the past.

Taken altogether, I would not be buying Apple on this minor dip. The stock continues to trade at a premium valuation despite its headwinds, with a forward price-to-earnings (P/E) ratio of nearly 35 times based on analysts' estimates for fiscal 2027 (which ends in September 2027).

AAPL PE Ratio (Forward) data by YCharts

The stock has benefited from huge multiple expansion over the past decade, but it's hard to see that continuing. As such, while Apple is a great company, I wouldn't be buying the stock right now.

news.Title: 美期中選舉變天 龔明鑫說免驚：川普掌行政權 關稅與對台友善態度一致
news.Content:
經濟部長龔明鑫今 (5) 日於部務會議會前受訪表示，針對美國期中選舉結果對台美關稅協定、德州園區開發與阿拉斯加天然氣投資計畫的潛在影響，他說明主導權仍在行政機關與總統，台美雙邊經貿合作建立在互利雙贏的基礎上，無論美國國會由何黨主導，對台友善與支持態度均保持高度一致。對於台積電 (2330-TW) (TSM-US) 赴美投資德州等議題，以及台美AI半導體產業生態系合作，龔明鑫強調，台美半導體供應鏈是全球效率最高的運作模式，經濟部將持續鞏固既有協議與合作成果。

在台美關稅協定與雙重避稅協定進度方面，市場關注若國會政黨結構改變，是否影響關稅政策或法案推動。龔明鑫說明，美國關稅政策主導權主要仍在行政機關與總統權限，若國會欲推翻總統決定需達三分之二高門檻，因此政府會持續努力鞏固過去已談定的良好成果。

針對台美避免雙重課稅協定，龔明鑫指出，眾議院先前已順利通過相關法案，參議院先前僅是法案排程時程問題，而非對內容存有異議，美兩黨對於深化台美經貿夥伴關係及支持台灣的立場相當一致。

針對德州園區推動與阿拉斯加天然氣投資計畫等海外佈局，龔明鑫表示，相關投資對台灣與美國而言皆具備互利雙贏效果，不僅有助於深化雙邊產業合作，更能創造在地就業機會。儘管各州選舉或新政局人事仍需時間確認，但台美雙向合作的大方向不會改變，經濟部會待美方相關人事安排與政局進一步確定後，持續推進細節對接。

至於阿拉斯加天然氣採購與投資規劃是否受環保議題或政黨更替影響，龔明鑫呼籲各界保持耐心，靜待美方選後整體戰略佈局與人事確定。

最後，面對市場傳出台積電向德州政府提出投資申請，龔明鑫回應，個別企業的具體海外投資佈局應由公司自行說明，經濟部不便代為評論。對於外界擔憂美政局變動是否衝擊台美AI半導體產業鏈，龔明鑫重申，台灣與美國建構的半導體供應鏈與生態系，是過去數十年來全球運作效率最高、成果最顯著的模式，對全球科技產業貢獻卓著。經濟部將持續深化與美方的半導體及高科技產業合作，確保台灣半導體產業在全球關鍵供應鏈中的核心地位。

news.Title: 1 Number That Should Concern Every Amazon Investor
news.Content:
For all intents and purposes, Amazon (NASDAQ: AMZN) had a fantastic third quarter. Revenue increased 12% year over year, and operating income was up 61%. This is the largest company in the world by sales, and conventional wisdom, as well as the law of large numbers, suggests that companies slow down as they get bigger. Not so Amazon, with its consistent double-digit growth.

The bulk of it is coming from the Amazon Web Services (AWS) cloud computing business . Although this segment has been around for a while now, it's recently been enjoying massive growth from artificial intelligence (AI) development, much of which happens through its cloud platform.

Missed AI's "Act 1"? Act 2 Could Be 16x Bigger. Most investors think they missed the AI boat because they didn't buy Nvidia in 2005. But according to our analysts, we're only at the end of "Act 1"—the R&D phase. "Act 2" is the global rollout. Continue »

AWS sales increased nearly 40% year over year in the third quarter, its highest in almost five years, and on a base about 4 times bigger; five years ago, AWS had $11.6 billion in third-quarter sales, and this year, it had $46 billion.

There was something else lurking behind this spectacular performance, though, and every investor should pay attention.

The biggest e-commerce business in the country

Amazon is unmatched in U.S. e-commerce , with 40.5% of the market share, according to Statista.

The company continues to roll out new features and improve its speed and delivery to keep its top spot. It had its fastest speed ever in the third quarter, with 1.5 million products reaching customers within 24 hours, and its ultrafast delivery, which delivers within 30 minutes, is now available in 450 towns and cities. Groceries are growing 3 times faster than other products and now represent about half of all units, and items ordered through Amazon Now, which delivers groceries within 30 minutes, increased tenfold in the quarter from last year.

Despite all that and more, e-commerce growth was weak in the third quarter. Online store sales were up only 2% from last year, and third-party sales were up 9%. That's a significant slowdown compared to recent quarters.

Metric

Q1 26

Q2 26

Q3 26

Online sales growth

Third-party sales growth

Data source: Amazon quarterly reports.

Online and third-party sales together were $115 billion in the third quarter, accounting for more than half of the total $201.9 billion. AI is dominating right now, but e-commerce is still the core business.

Story Continues

At the same time, Walmart has been demonstrating robust e-commerce growth, with a 23% increase in global sales in the 2027 fiscal second quarter (ended July 31) and a 24% increase in the U.S. market. It's been reporting similar growth for a while, and it also moved up in U.S. e-commerce market share, from 6.7% to 9.2%. That's still solidly second place, but this is an important trend to follow. No company, however big, is immune to the threat of competition, and investors shouldn't forget about e-commerce as Amazon continues to plow money into AI.

news.Title: Burford Capital Q3 Earnings Call Highlights
news.Content:
Key Points

Interested in Burford Capital Limited? Here are five stocks we like better.

Year-to-date revenue more than doubled versus the same period last year, with $116 million in capital provision income and a 13.4% annualized return on equity. Management said rising interest rates hurt non-cash valuations; without that impact, revenue and capital provision income would each have exceeded $200 million.

A post-quarter settlement generated about $64 million in cash and returned more than 11 times Burford's investment. Other major matters include a $600 million-plus arbitration award against Cameroon, a large Apple patent verdict, and ongoing proceedings in the YPF case; executives emphasized that outcomes and timing remain uncertain.

Burford reduced total debt by $100 million , while quarter-end liquidity stood at $514 million. Management is weighing further deleveraging against new investments and has prioritized liquidity over some lower-return opportunities.

3 Retail Stocks Getting Crushed and the Long-Dated Options Trade on Each One

Burford Capital (NYSE:BUR) reported higher year-to-date revenue in its third-quarter earnings call, while executives said interest rate movements weighed on non-cash valuations and the company reduced debt by $100 million.

CEO Chris Bogart said revenue for the year to date was more than double the comparable period last year. The company reported capital provision income of $116 million and annualized return on equity of 13.4%, despite what Bogart described as the largest negative interest-rate impact Burford has experienced.

→ 3 Waste Services Stocks With More Growth Than You Might Expect

With the RSI at a Record Low, Is It Time to Go Bargain Hunting on Burlington?

The company earned $0.10 per share, bringing book value to just under $4 per share, Chief Financial Officer Jordan Licht said. Year-to-date net realized gains were $82 million, compared with $93 million a year earlier, while asset management income rose to $29 million from $21 million.

Bogart said changes in discount rates affect interim fair value accounting rather than the cash ultimately generated by a case. Without the interest-rate headwinds, he said, capital provision income and revenue would each have exceeded $200 million, and annualized return on equity would have been well into the 40% range.

Fourth-quarter settlement and case developments

→ AbbVie's Humira Era Is Fading, But Its New Growth Engines Face Another Test

3 Retail Stocks to Watch After a Big Consumer Earnings Week

Story Continues

After the third quarter ended, Burford completed a settlement that generated approximately $64 million in cash and returned more than 11 times its investment, according to executives. The asset had been recorded at just under $31 million in capital provision assets at the end of the third quarter, Licht said.

Bogart said the case illustrated why an older litigation investment is not necessarily a poor one. An important appellate ruling in 2020 set the case up for trial, he said, but the process took another six years amid pandemic-related court delays.

→ Big Tech Is Spending Billions on AI—These 5 Stocks Are Getting Paid

Chief Investment Officer Jon Molot said Burford has now generated more than $4 billion in cumulative cash realizations since the business began 17 years ago. He cautioned that the timing of case outcomes remains unpredictable from quarter to quarter.

Bogart also discussed two other litigation developments. An arbitration tribunal awarded more than $600 million in an African mining matter against Cameroon, with Burford entitled to approximately one-third, he said. The matter still faces further proceedings and enforcement.

A patent case involving Apple produced what Bogart described as the largest U.S. patent verdict in history. He cautioned that a contested verdict can be followed by post-trial proceedings and an appeal. Licht said milestones are generally accounted for in the quarter in which they occur, but did not specify the valuation impact of that verdict.

On the YPF case, Bogart said nine third-party amicus briefs had been filed with the U.S. Supreme Court. He said the matter was likely to go through arbitration, although proceedings in U.S. courts had not fully concluded.

Debt reduction competes with new investments

Burford retired its entire 2028 debt maturity and issued new 2029 debt during the quarter. The transactions reduced total debt outstanding by $100 million and lowered the debt-to-tangible-book-value ratio by roughly one-third of a turn, executives said.

Liquidity was $514 million at quarter-end, down from $621 million at the start of the year, Licht said. The company also had $120 million due from settlements, excluding the fourth-quarter settlement.

Management said it is balancing further debt reduction against opportunities to invest in new cases. Licht said year-to-date definitive commitments declined from a year earlier, partly reflecting a recent decision to prioritize liquidity and deleveraging over opportunities offering more moderate expected returns.

Bogart said the company has been less inclined this year to pursue some larger, lower-risk transactions with comparatively lower returns. He declined to provide a target for quarterly new commitments. Licht said Burford does not have a fixed minimum liquidity figure or an exact debt-to-equity target.

The fair value of assets in the principal finance portfolio rose from $2.3 billion to just under $2.5 billion during the quarter, Licht said. He added that the company typically deploys roughly $100 million per quarter, though the amount varies.

Expenses and outlook

Licht said $28 million of the company's $31 million in year-to-date case-related expenditures represented investment costs that could not be capitalized under accounting rules. Approximately $17 million to $18 million of that amount related to costs deployed in a previous year that were unwound and expensed this year.

Asked about $10 million in annual compensation savings, Licht said the reductions were predominantly in middle management and that Burford did not expect them to impair its ability to manage the portfolio or pursue growth.

Management did not provide an updated figure for modeled realizations. Licht said Burford updates that estimate annually and plans to provide the next update with its year-end reporting.

About Burford Capital (NYSE:BUR)

Burford Capital Limited (NYSE: BUR) is a global legal finance and asset management firm. The company provides capital to businesses and law firms involved in commercial litigation and arbitration, allowing clients to finance legal expenses, manage risk, or access the potential value of legal claims and judgments without relying solely on their balance sheets.

Its services include single-case and portfolio litigation finance, post-settlement and judgment monetization, legal asset management, and corporate legal finance.

news.Title: 台股狂殺8千點別猜底！ 專家勸先算「1數字」：睡不著就該賣了
news.Content:
台股不到一個月蒸發8,247點，財經專家股海老牛指出，面對大盤暴跌千萬別猜底，應花十分鐘精算部位風險，強調「部位合身的人，跌的是帳面；部位太大的人，跌的是生活」。

台股慘崩8千點櫃買更慘烈

股海老牛談到，台股近期走勢相當難看。加權指數在10/6收在49,822點，今天則收在41,575點，一個月便蒸發了8,247點，整體跌幅約16.6%。檢視這週走勢更是嚴峻，11/3單日重挫1,612點，昨天看到長下影線讓大家才剛喘口氣，今天又再殺1,374點。盤中最低來到41,514點，收盤幾乎就收在最低點附近，尾盤完全沒有像樣的反彈。櫃買指數更為慘烈，單日跌幅高達6.41%，中小型股的投資人應該特別有感。

用實質金額檢視跌幅

這幾天打開群組，大家的詢問已經從「要不要加碼」慢慢變成「到底還要跌多久」，帳戶大失血之外，情緒也跟著受影響。這種時候如果是以猜底心態來看，壓力會越來越大，最後一口氣炸掉反而更慘。股海老牛表示：「先別猜，先算。」他建議改用「金額」來看，別只看「%」。因為-16%聽起來只是一個數字，換成金額就不一樣了。100萬的部位，16.6%就是16.6萬，可能是好幾個月的薪水。如果這個數字讓你半夜一直滑手機看夜盤，問題可能不是股票不好，而是部位太大。同樣跌16%，有人睡得著，有人睡不著，差別往往就在部位大小。

精算槓桿追繳安全距離

針對開槓桿的投資人，股海老牛強調「不是站在場外說風涼話」，自己本身就有辦理股票質押，上週末已經先算過一次。多數券商股票質押的追繳線大約在130%，用這條線反推發現，自己的A帳戶要再跌7成才會碰線，但B帳戶再跌24%就會碰線。同樣是質押，安全距離差很多，所以這波如果要盯，B帳戶才是重點。真的跌近警戒區，選項不外乎補擔保品、先還一部分，或降低借款，越早想好越不會手忙腳亂。此外利息也不能忘了，股價會休息，利息不會，每個月照樣準時扣款。

無獲利熱門股最先倒

投資人應看看有沒有哪一檔股票「早就負太多」，特別是不賺錢、卻很熱門的散戶股，甚至已經跌超過兩成的那幾檔。這類股票最常見的狀況是當初因為題材買進，跌了捨不得賣，越跌越想攤平，最後部位不知不覺變大。大盤一回檔，它通常跌得比誰都深，今天櫃買跌幅是大盤的兩倍就是例子。沒有獲利撐腰的股價就像沒有地基的房子，颱風一來最先倒的往往就是它。

算完帳睡得著才抱緊

股海老牛形容，大跌就像颱風警報。我們決定不了颱風走哪條路，但可以先把窗戶關好、把屋頂補好。他非常喜歡這句話：「部位合身的人，跌的是帳面；部位太大的人，跌的是生活。」他建議給自己10分鐘，把「再跌20%」的金額和維持率實際算一次。算完還睡得著，就照計畫抱緊處理；睡不著，那就是該調整的訊號。

news.Title: Nebius Stock: The Bull Case, the Bear Case, and My Call Before Nov. 12
news.Content:
When I last covered Nebius Group (NASDAQ:NBIS) in mid-October, the stock was near $165, and I said I was still waiting to buy. Shares have kept falling since then.

Even after jumping about 7% on Nov. 3, the stock is near $152 as I write -- off about 47% from June 18, when it closed at a record $286.69.

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

Two more things have changed. The artificial intelligence (AI) cloud provider announced a $3.5 billion financing facility from Citigroup on Oct. 22. And it'll post third-quarter results on Thursday, Nov. 12, before the open.

Image source: Getty Images.

The bull case

The strongest argument for the stock is Nebius' own target. Management expects to finish 2026 with annualized run-rate revenue of $7 billion to $9 billion. (Nebius multiplies a quarter's last month of AI cloud revenue by 12 to get it.) At the end of June, it was $3.0 billion.

That seems like a big jump. But Nebius has arguably been growing at close to the pace it needs.

Showing how fast the company is scaling, Nebius' run-rate revenue went from $1.25 billion at the end of 2025 to $1.9 billion in March, a gain of around 54%. Growth then sped up a little, with run-rate revenue climbing 56% to $3.0 billion by the end of June. Second-quarter revenue , meanwhile, jumped 454% year over year. Two more quarters at the recent pace would take run-rate revenue to around $7 billion, the low end of the company's range.

And Nebius has topped a goal like this before, finishing 2025 above its own forecast for $900 million to $1.1 billion in run-rate revenue.

What's more, pricing might help it go further. Deals Nebius signed in the second quarter averaged over $20 million in annual contract value per megawatt of capacity, compared with around $12 million across its 2026 base. Most of them were signed for capacity due late this year, so the bigger boost might show up in 2027 revenue.

Demand doesn't look like the problem, either.

"We could sell our entire 2027 capacity on these terms today," founder and CEO Arkady Volozh said in his second-quarter letter to shareholders.

Valued at around $44 billion, Nebius trades at about 5.5 times the annualized revenue it's targeting by year-end, using the midpoint. If management pulls it off, I think that price is modest for a company growing so fast.

Story Continues

The bear case

The problem is what all this costs to build. Nebius expects capital expenditures of $20 billion to $25 billion this year, and it spent around $8.1 billion on equipment and other capital purchases in the first half. That leaves around $12 billion to $17 billion to spend in just six months.

So far, Nebius has filled much of that gap with outside money. It sold 12.7 million shares in the second quarter at an average price of around $224. It raised about $5.75 billion with convertible notes in August. And the new Citigroup facility lasts for just 364 days, so it will have to be repaid or replaced within a year.

Yes, customer prepayments help. Nebius expects to collect over $9 billion of them this year.

But with the stock around $152, any extra share sales could dilute current holders more than the second-quarter sales did. And if lenders become more cautious about AI data center projects, the rest of the build-out could cost more to fund.

Revenue is also concentrated. Three customers accounted for 59% of second-quarter revenue, and Microsoft alone has a contract worth up to $19.4 billion.

Is Nebius stock a buy before Nov. 12?

The lower price helps a bit. In October, I put Nebius at around 15 times the revenue it expects for 2026. It's about 14 times that revenue now, using the midpoint of its $3.0 billion to $3.4 billion outlook.

But price wasn't the biggest thing holding me back. The year-end target needs the next two quarters to grow about as fast as the past two, while Nebius funds capital spending of around seven times this year's expected revenue.

The third-quarter report should give the September run-rate. A figure around $4.6 billion would keep Nebius on track for the low end of its target. Anything well under that might put the year-end target out of reach.

My call is to wait another week for that number. Nebius is growing extremely fast, and I think the stock might look cheap in hindsight if management delivers. Sure, waiting could mean paying a higher price if the quarter is strong. With the report so close, I'm willing to run that risk.

news.Title: 名師操盤》台股連6黑再探波段新低！恐慌賣壓出籠 5檔轉機股出列
news.Content:
美國期中選舉之後，市場停戰預期升溫，油價一度大跌近10%，美股漲多跌少。只是隨著投資人擔心AI資料中心的未來建設恐會生變，勝選的民主黨將強化對AI產業的監管、審查與稅務負擔，美股科技股偏弱，費城半導體下跌逾3%。

周四的台股在權值電子領跌下，指數開低走低，盤中最低來到41513點，再創回檔以來新低，終場下跌1374點，以41574點作收，K線六連黑，成交量為9260億元，較前一日的1.11兆元，呈現價跌量縮。昨日大量換手的籌碼，隨著周四行情未能續攻，部分成為套牢賣壓，這對於行情的反彈較為不利。

以日K線來看，指數六連黑，周四行情再創新低，跌破周三長下影線的低點，顯示多方抵抗失敗，行情跌勢未歇。目前觀察下方4萬點的整數關卡，還有年線，目前位置在38784點，是否有支撐力道。之前提過多方至少要維持3-5天不破底，行情才算初步止穩。而要反攻，則要出現日級別的日出訊號才算數。在此之前，行情仍有探底危機；而要進一步穩住，行情則要站回半年線與季線之上，目前半年線位置在45360點，而季線位置在46490點，市場信心才會回升。

若以周K線來看，周日落後，中線跌勢未完，先前提過轉折的前提是周K線先出現十字線或小紅，隨著周四再創新低，本周至今的周K線走出長黑，轉折時間點延後，至於OTC指數，由於率先跌破年線，架構比加權指數還要弱勢，周四盤中來到321.23點，再創波段新低。以台股的日KD指標來看，目前日KD值持續在20以下的弱勢格局，由於時間已超過3天，等於空方持續主導行情，後續容易引發籌碼進一步鬆動，不利多方匯集人氣。

以周四收盤時來看，上市的上漲家數165家，下跌家數816家，而上櫃的上漲家數115家，下跌家數657家，上市櫃合計的下跌家數持續大於上漲家數。周四上市漲停家數為5檔漲停，上櫃漲停家數為5檔漲停，合計漲停家數為10檔漲停，低於40家基本觀察門檻，而周四上市跌停家數為56檔，上櫃跌停家數為59檔，合計跌停家數為115檔漲停，顯示賣壓全面出籠，恐慌氣氛蔓延。

操作上，目前泛AI族群出現了籌碼鬆動現象，而部分業績佳的強勢股（如台玻、富喬）也在周四出現補跌，等於是全面下跌。這種加速趕底的走法通常出現在跌勢的末段，不用過度恐慌。只是由於籌碼已凌亂，資金在短期內不容易拉抬相同族群，故未來3~5天要觀察是否有新起漲，剛表態的族群出列。

受惠停戰預期，油價大跌，航空股的營運成本可望下降，如華航、長榮航、台灣虎航等可留意。而隨著川普關稅可望受制衡，加上明年接單可期，成衣的儒鴻、聚陽等也有買盤進駐，可持續追蹤。

news.Title: 1 Reason to Hold Coca-Cola Stock for 10 Years
news.Content:
Coca-Cola (NYSE: KO) shares are up about 35% this year as of midday trading on Nov. 3, beating the S&P 500 's (SNPINDEX: ^GSPC) roughly 11% gain. Even at this valuation, the best reason to hold it for the next decade hasn't changed: Coca-Cola can raise prices without losing customers.

That's rare in consumer goods, where shoppers often trade down when prices rise. Last quarter, Coca-Cola 's price increases added about four percentage points to sales growth, yet unit case volume still grew 5% year over year.

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

Over the past 50 years, Coca-Cola's annual volume has declined only once, during the pandemic, and research firm Kantar ranked Coca-Cola the world's most valuable food and beverage brand. Management's long-term plan is to balance unit volume growth with price increases. Over a decade, that steady combination can compound earnings and dividends.

Strong brand power doesn't mean Coca-Cola can't see slower growth. Management said cost pressures have intensified and expects value to remain a major concern for consumers in 2027. If Coca-Cola can't raise prices enough to cover its costs, margins could shrink, and its pricing power would look weaker.

Still, investors get paid to wait. The stock yields about 2.2%, about twice the S&P 500's yield, and Coca-Cola has raised its dividend for 64 straight years. With fourth-quarter results and the first 2027 guidance due in February, investors will soon see whether that pricing power carries into next year.

news.Title: 永豐期貨：美選後費半重挫3%！加權指數重挫1,374點
news.Content:
【財訊快報／編輯部】期貨走勢，指數週四下跌1374.19點，收在41574.72點，成交量0.98兆元。台指期下跌1321點至41882點，正價差為307.28點。籌碼面部分，三大法人賣超1234.57億元；而在台指期淨部位方面，三大法人淨空單增加1852口至-3038口，其中外資淨空單增加2004口至-95651口；十大交易人中的特定法人全月份台指期淨多單減少4532口至8962口。美國期中選舉由民主黨拿下參眾兩院，昨晚費城半導體指數重挫3.13%影響台股走勢，台股今日開低走低，早盤開在42,666點後一度彈至42,874點，惟高點過後賣壓隨即湧現，指數快速下殺，盤中雖一度反彈至42,400點附近，，最低下探41,514點，終場重挫1,374點（-3.20%），收在41,575點。今日成交量9,260億元。盤面上下跌家數1,030家（其中跌停56家），遠多於上漲275家。

個股表現上，前波主流股的龍頭幾乎全數摜上跌停，ASIC指標創意(3443)、PCB指標台光電(2383)、玻纖布指標南亞(1303)、ABF載板指標欣興(3037)、記憶體指標南亞科(2408)同日跌停，散熱指標奇鋐(3017)也狂瀉9.04%。權值股同步重挫，日月光投控(3711)跌8.77%，AI伺服器指標緯穎(6669)跌7.56%，台達電(2308)跌7.38%，聯發科(2454)重挫6.86%，聯電(2303)重挫6.73%、跌破100元。相對地，台積電(2330)僅小跌0.88%，金融股逆勢收紅，中信金(2891)漲2.32%，國泰金(2882)小漲0.90%、富邦金(2881)小漲0.65%，中華電(2412)則收平盤。

整體來看，美國選舉結果讓美股出現明顯的分流：選舉的不確定性落地帶動道瓊大漲，但市場擔心AI監管趨嚴，費半、輝達、美光與資料中心類股反而同步走弱，而台股的權重正好集中在後者。今天跌停的創意、台光電、欣興、南亞科，分別落在ASIC、PCB、載板與記憶體這幾條AI供應鏈上，跟美股走弱的族群幾乎重疊，跌停56家也是這波回檔以來最多。前一交易日那根千點下影線沒有帶來止穩，收盤已經跌破昨日的盤中低點，量能也從兆元回落。相對地，台積電跌幅不到1%，金融股再度逆勢收紅，成了今天指數僅存的支撐。後續可留意台積電與金融股這兩個位置還能撐多久，以及美國AI監管的方向是否進一步明朗。

選擇權分析，選擇權未平倉量部分，11月買權最大OI落在48000點，賣權最大OI落在38000點；11月F1買權最大OI落在46500點，賣權最大OI落在40000點。全月份未平倉量put/call ratio值由0.49下降至0.44。VIX指數上升4.27至39.92。外資台指期買權淨金額-0.14億元；賣權淨金額2.9億元。

news.Title: 台股1個月暴跌逾8000點　證交所籲回歸基本面理性判斷
news.Content:
（中央社記者曾仁凱台北2026年11月5日電）台股連日下跌，今天終場大跌1374.19點，收在41574.72點，自10月6日的盤中指數歷史高點49968.92點，短短1個月回檔逾8000點。台灣證券交易所今天發出新聞稿，強調台股相對於國際股市仍展現韌性，呼籲投資人回歸企業基本面及長期投資價值理性判斷。

證交所指出，受惠全球AI應用快速發展，帶動半導體及相關供應鏈需求強勁，台灣科技產業競爭優勢持續展現。今年截至11月4日，台股加權股價指數累計上漲48.29%，漲幅領先國際主要股市。近期受國際科技類股回檔及全球金融市場波動影響，台股相較於國際股市震盪，表現仍相對穩健。

證交所統計2026年各主要市場最高收盤指數與11月4日相比，台灣加權指數回落13.80%，幅度明顯小於美國費城半導體指數的29.83%及韓國KOSPI指數的37.64%，也低於日本日經225指數的14.06%和香港恆生指數的14.48%，顯示台股在市場修正期間展現相對抗跌韌性。

證交所表示，台灣經濟基本面穩健，上市公司營運及獲利表現亮眼，資本市場具備良好發展基礎。證交所已推出「台股儀表板」，整合證券商授信業務、投資人違約概況及上市櫃公司營收等重要市場資訊，提供融資及擔保維持率等相關交易數據，協助投資人掌握市場現況及長期變化。

面對短期市場波動，證交所呼籲投資人善用相關資訊，審慎評估自身風險承受能力，留意融資等槓桿交易風險，並回歸企業基本面及長期投資價值理性判斷。

證交所引述行政院主計總處10月30日公布的2026年第3季經濟成長率概估達14.36%，前3季成長14.22%，為半世紀以來同期新高。9月出口達872.2億美元，創歷年單月新高，年增60.9%；外銷訂單達1142.1億美元，亦創歷史新高，年增62.4%，顯示外需動能持續強勁。

上市公司營運方面，全體上市公司今年前3季營收達46兆9593億元，年增38.61%。上半年全體上市公司稅後淨利達3兆4377億元，年增136.7%，營收與獲利同步展現強勁成長。

此外，今年以來集中市場日均成交值近新台幣1兆元，市場流動性維持充沛。

news.Title: 恐慌殺盤！台股跌無止境？證交所出手了
news.Content:
近期受國際股市震盪與科技類股回檔影響，台股加權股價指數於今（5）日收在41,574.72點，下跌1,374.19點，跌幅3.2%。不過，綜觀全年表現，台股展現出相對國際主要市場更為穩健的抗跌韌性，今年截至11月4日累計漲幅達48.29%，領先全球主要股市；且與各主要市場今年最高收盤指數相比，台股回落幅度僅13.80%，明顯小於美國費城半導體（29.83%）與韓國KOSPI（37.64%），市場日均成交值更維持近新台幣1兆元的高水準。

總體經濟與上市公司獲利雙創新高

台股展現抗跌韌性的背後，反映的是台灣堅實的總體經濟與企業基本面。行政院主計總處公布115年第三季經濟成長率概估達14.36%，前三季成長14.22%，創下半世紀以來同期新高。在強勁外需帶動下，9月出口與外銷訂單分別達到872.2億美元與1,142.1億美元，雙雙創下歷年單月新高，年增率分別高達60.9%與62.4%。

國內外主要機構紛紛上修我國今年經濟成長率，主計總處上修至11.05%，創近39年新高；中央銀行上修至11.48%，國際貨幣基金（IMF）更大幅上修至10.7%，居亞太地區之冠。展望明年，在 AI 需求與民間投資持續擴增下，經濟成長動能可望延續，且前三季消費者物價指數（CPI）平均年增率僅1.94%，維持溫和水準。

上市公司營運表現同樣亮眼，9月全體上市公司營收達新台幣6兆3,402億元，年增43.69%；前三季累計營收達46兆9,593億元，年增38.61%。此外，今年上半年全體上市公司稅後淨利高達3兆4,377億元，年增幅達136.7%，營收與獲利同步強勁成長。

AI 效應外溢　國際評比肯定

在產業前景方面，國發會9月景氣對策信號續亮紅燈，已創下連續10個月紅燈的歷史最長紀錄，且 AI 效應已由半導體逐步外溢至傳統產業，紅燈預期將延續至年底。隨著全球科技巨頭加速布局 AI 基礎建設，台灣供應鏈中長期發展基礎穩固。

台灣的投資環境亦獲國際高度肯定，依據瑞士洛桑管理學院（IMD）2026年世界競爭力排名，台灣在70個受評比國家中高居第4名，在人口超過2千萬人的經濟體中連續6年蟬聯世界第1；在亞洲公司治理協會（ACGA）公布的「CG Watch 2026」評鑑中，台灣也與新加坡並列第3名。

證交所呼籲：理性評估風險　回歸基本面

面對近期國際政經情勢帶動的短期市場波動，證交所表示，將持續密切關注國際政經情勢及市場交易動態，強化市場監控與風險管理，並督促上市公司即時進行重大資訊揭露，同時鼓勵上市公司藉由舉辦法說會加強與投資大眾的雙向溝通。

證交所強調，台灣資本市場具備良好發展基礎，並已推出「台股儀表板」整合證券商授信業務、投資人違約概況及上市櫃公司營收等重要市場資訊。證交所指出，投資人在面對短期市場波動時，宜善用相關資訊，審慎評估自身風險承受能力，留意融資等槓桿交易風險，並回歸企業基本面與長期投資價值進行理性判斷。

news.Title: 外資狂賣台股並匯出，新台幣爆量連四貶，週四以32.876元作收
news.Content:
【財訊快報／劉敏夫】台北外匯市場週四新台幣兌美元匯價爆量走貶。市場憂心民主黨掌控美國國會將導致人工智能(AI)資本支出放緩，使得台股週四持續面臨外資為首法人賣壓而殺跌，加權指數重挫3.20%，外資賣超上市股票1,024.6億元，本週累計賣超逾4,300億元，帶動台幣盤中再破32.9元價位直探32.985，表現再度落後於其他主要亞幣，連續四日走貶。美民主黨勝選、美元指數走弱，亞洲主要貨幣今日齊升，新台幣匯率獨弱，週四以32.876元作收，與前一交易日比較，台幣匯率貶值5.5分。銀行間新台幣兌美元最高成交價為32.840元，最低成交價為32.985元，成交量為36億5,600萬美元。

以未被授權公開評論為由要求匿名的兩位外匯交易員表示，外資持續匯出資金，但公股銀行及出口商賣出美元的力道超過上日，一定程度上限制台幣貶勢。

TS Lombard首席中國與東亞新興市場經濟專家Rory Green等人於報告中指出，在AI需求持續強勁之下，台灣央行面臨的壓力正日益升高，不僅可能需要升息，也可能必須容許台幣走強。

這份報告指出，11月地方選舉可能成為台幣升值的觸發因素。同時，台幣最明顯的風險則是科技股出現更廣泛的拋售。

news.Title: 暴跌1374點別慌 證交所端台股獲利3.4兆元強心針抗跌
news.Content:
受國際科技股回檔衝擊，台股5日終場大跌1374.19點，收在41574.72點，跌幅3.2％；面對盤面震盪，證交所5日強調，台股自高點回落僅13.80％，遠比美韓股市抗跌，官方更端出前3季逾14％的經濟成長率，以及上市公司上半年狂賺逾3.4兆元的獲利強心針，力挺多頭信心。

證交所指出，在AI熱潮帶動下，台股今年截至11月4日累計大漲48.29％，漲幅領先國際主要股市，對比各市場今年最高收盤指數，台股回落13.80％，修正幅度遠小於美股費半指數的29.83％與南韓KOSPI指數的37.64％，亦低於日經與港股，展現強勁抗跌韌性，此外，台股集中市場日均成交值逼近1兆元，流動性充沛，足以消化短期賣壓。

證交所表示，主計總處概估前3季經濟成長率達14.22％，創半世紀以來同期新高；9月出口872.2億美元、外銷訂單1142.1億美元，同步刷新歷史單月天價，年增均飆破6成，主計總處與央行將今年成長率上修至11.05％與11.48％，IMF更估達10.7％稱霸亞太；加上國發會景氣燈號連10紅創紀錄，AI紅利持續外溢至傳產。

上市公司獲利更是官方力阻市場踩踏的王牌。全體上市公司9月營收衝出6兆3402億元，前3季累計達46兆9593億元，年增38.61％；上半年稅後淨利狂飆至3兆4377億元，年增136.7％，展望明年，官方預估經濟成長率仍有近6％水準，物價指數（CPI）約2％，維持穩健成長與溫和通膨態勢。

面對短線劇震，證交所強調將強化動態監控，11月排定22家上市公司辦理法說會，督促即時揭露資訊，同時呼籲，投資人應善用先前推出的「台股儀表板」掌握信用交易與槓桿風險，切莫因單日重跌慌亂殺出，回歸企業獲利實力與中長期價值理性布局。

news.Title: 民主黨大勝美股先崩後拉回、金銀齊揚 市場押注「誰也動不了誰」
news.Content:
民主黨在美國期中選舉大勝、奪回國會兩院，全球市場隨即上演「先崩後拉」。這波反轉背後，是投資人從擔憂AI監管收緊，轉向押注分權政府形成政策僵局，限制財政擴張，也讓民主黨推動新政策的空間受限。

回顧選後市場反應，美股期貨與亞洲股市先重挫，隨後跌幅收斂，韓股更一度黑翻紅；黃金漲逾2%，白銀同步走高。

民主黨不僅拿下眾參兩院，更在德州、南卡羅來納州、堪薩斯州及愛荷華州等共和黨傳統優勢地區勝出，促使市場重新評估美國財政、科技監管與利率前景。

勝選幅度超預期 市場先賣再說

高盛選前已指出，眾議院結果大致反映在市場價格中，參議院才是意外的主要來源。最終讓市場震驚的，是參議院翻轉幅度，以及民主黨在共和黨防守地區的突破。

風險資產隨即遭到拋售。那斯達克100指數期貨一度跌逾2%，標普500指數期貨跌逾1%，VIX恐慌指數期貨突破20。

亞洲市場同步承壓，日經225指數一度跌逾4%，韓國綜合股價指數也一度下挫4%。

匯市則出現避險資金流動，彭博美元現貨指數下跌0.4%，日元兌美元升值0.5%，瑞郎上漲0.7%，漲幅居G10貨幣之首。

川普仍握否決權 恐慌逐漸退潮

市場隨後意識到，民主黨掌控國會雖可阻擋川普的立法議程，卻不代表能順利推動自己的政策。川普仍握有總統否決權，雙方相互制衡，政策僵局因此成為市場重新定價的核心。

Stifel首席華盛頓政策策略師Brian Gardner先前指出，市場最初的反應可能逆轉，因為投資人將認知到，政策僵局才是最可能的結果。

景順全球市場策略師Tomo Kinoshita也認為，民主黨大勝引發的AI監管疑慮似乎有些反應過度，即使下屆國會通過收緊監管的法案，川普仍可否決。

摩根資產管理亞太區首席市場策略師許長泰則指出，川普仍掌握貿易、關稅、外交政策與現行監管架構等工具，分權政府對其實際施政能力的影響有限。

隨著這套邏輯發酵，韓股由跌轉漲，日股與台股跌幅明顯收斂，美股期貨也逐步收復部分失土。

財政擴張恐受阻 美債成為受惠者

相較於股市震盪，美債受惠的邏輯更直接。民主黨控制國會，可能壓縮川普擴大赤字與推動減稅的立法空間，降低聯邦借貸壓力，對規模約40兆美元的美國國債構成利多。

美債殖利率全面下滑，5年期殖利率一度下跌9個基點至4.68%，10年期下跌7個基點至4.89%，之後降幅有所收斂。

惠靈頓管理投資組合經理Brij Khurana表示，分權政府意味近年高水準的財政支出將受到約束，歷史上這種政治格局通常有利美債。野村利率策略

news.Title: Why Rocket Lab Stock Plunged 15% in October and Why Its Decline Might Be Short-Lived
news.Content:
Last month was a tough one for Rocket Lab (NASDAQ:RKLB) shareholders, as the stock tumbled 21.5%, according to data supplied by S&P Global Market Intelligence .

Missed AI's "Act 1"? Act 2 Could Be 16x Bigger. Most investors think they missed the AI boat because they didn't buy Nvidia in 2005. But according to our analysts, we're only at the end of "Act 1"—the R&D phase. "Act 2" is the global rollout. Continue »

The broader market edged lower last month, with the S&P 500 down 0.9% during the same period. However, the launch and satellite specialist fell much further, as recent developments regarding its Neutron rocket captured the attention of investors.

Image source: Getty Images.

Delay of game

In a press release that dropped on Oct. 14, the company provided an update on the launch of its highly anticipated Neutron rocket. The inaugural launch of the partially reusable medium-lift, two-stage rocket -- scheduled for later this year -- was pushed into 2027.

Beyond the somewhat terse announcement, CEO Peter Beck appeared in an accompanying video to provide insight into the decision.

We believe Neutron is going to be a game changer, and taking the time now to solve these challenges means we're in a better position to deliver a rocket that's ready to meet the needs of the industry for years to come.

The chief executive went on to say Rocket Lab has identified an issue in the manufacturing process that resulted in voids (air pockets) between the layers of carbon fiber in the propellant dome. This could have affected the rocket's strength, reliability, and durability.

Management noted that Rocket Lab has since corrected the issue after changes to the manufacturing process. Since then, a propellant dome made using a different process has been completed and passed inspection.

Rocket Lab provided another update in a post on X on Oct. 28. The company announced that Neutron's Stage 2 and Thrust Modules had arrived at the launch complex in Virginia.

To be clear, we don't know for sure when the Neutron rocket will ultimately fly. Management originally envisioned its inaugural launch in 2024, but the timeline has been pushed back several times as development of the next-generation space vehicle faced challenges. That said, Rocket Lab has been clear that "a reliable rocket is far more valuable than an early one," and that safety is the company's top priority.

Is Rocket Lab stock a buy?

With the space race heating up, Rocket Lab is an enigmatic choice for investors. Its plans to acquire Iridium Communications (NASDAQ:IRDM) take it one step closer to its goal of being an end-to-end space company. Progress on the Neutron rocket is slow but sure, and just this week, Rocket Lab announced the 99th successful launch of its Electron rocket.

Story Continues

I can't stress enough that this is a high-risk, high-reward investment, but as a small part of a well-balanced portfolio, I think Rocket Lab makes an intriguing addition.

Missed AI's "Act 1"? Act 2 Could Be 14x Bigger

Most investors think they missed the AI boat because they didn't buy Nvidia in 2005.

But according to our analysts, we're only at the end of "Act 1"—the R&D phase. "Act 2" is the global rollout, a massive technology build-out that Google's CEO says could be more profound than fire or electricity.

While everyone watches the chip designers, one "backbone" company provides the critical technology that Nvidia and AMD literally cannot function without. We've detailed this under-the-radar player in our new AI Playbook.

Continue »

Danny Vena, CPA has no position in any of the stocks mentioned. The Motley Fool has positions in and recommends Rocket Lab. The Motley Fool has a disclosure policy .

news.Title: 選後行情怎押寶？專家解密：府會分治不改美股長多 1年後科技股平均漲幅近31%
news.Content:
美國期中選舉出現「藍潮」，民主黨有望取得參眾兩院多數席次並拿下俄亥俄州與德州州長。儘管短線市場需消化AI資料中心、金融監管與對外政策的潛在變化，富蘭克林證券投顧表示，隨著選後不確定性釐清，美股評價面吸引力浮現。歷史統計顯示，1990年以來美期中選舉後1年，史坦普500指數上漲機率高達100%，平均報酬率達14.46%，其中資訊科技類股平均漲幅更衝上30.93%。

富蘭克林證券投顧分析，儘管民主黨掌控參眾兩院、總統為共和黨的情境下，政策可能面臨較多拉鋸，但歷史數據顯示美股長期多頭格局並未改變。統計1933年至2025年期間，當國會由同政黨掌握、總統屬另一政黨時，史坦普500指數年化報酬率仍達11.7%，依舊展現出亮眼表現。

富蘭克林坦伯頓穩定月收益基金經理人愛德華‧波克指出，美國經濟成長的核心動能依然穩固，持續受到強勁資本投資與消費支出支撐。目前殖利率走高，使投資級債券殖利率來到逾20年最具吸引力的水準之一。面對個股波動加劇與產業分化，靈活調整資產配置、進行跨產業多元化布局，成為掌握價格錯置時進場加碼的關鍵。

進一步檢視1990年至2022年美期中選舉後1年的各產業表現，除了資訊科技以30.93%平均報酬率領跑外，耐久財（17.02%）、工業（13.48%）、通訊服務（12.88%）、健康醫療（12.47%）、原物料（12.08%）及金融（12.05%）等產業均有超過雙位數的亮眼報酬，上漲機率普遍介於67%至100%之間。

法人建議，著眼2027年全球企業獲利預期呈現兩位數增長，投資人宜採股債平衡與產業分散配置策略，並可關注如富蘭克林坦伯頓穩定月收益基金等均衡配置於美股與高收益債券的標的，藉由建立跨資產與跨風格的低相關性組合抵禦市場波動，同時鎖定股息與債息收益。

news.Title: 《台股盤後》重挫1374點失守42K，外資續賣千億
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-11-05 15:27:31 新聞中心 發佈

費半指數週三逆勢下跌逾3%、NASDAQ電子盤亦持續走弱下，台股今(5)日早盤雖一度由台積領軍翻紅，不過重量級權值股台光電及南亞跌停、南亞科及奇鋐重挫、聯發科也跌近7%，而昨日盤中急拉的日月光及摑巨*盤中亦明顯轉弱，且台塑化受制油價大跌而跌停下，多頭信心無法凝聚、19大類股也轉為跌多漲少，加權指數盤中拉抬無力後，終場收在41574.72點、失守4萬2關卡，下跌1374.19點或3.20%，成交量9260.24億元。

民主黨在期中選舉大獲全勝，再加上油價重挫逾8%，緩解政治不確定因素，激勵道瓊工業平均指數大漲逾1,500點、寫下2025年4月以來最大單日漲幅，惟費城半導體指數因AI監管恐趨嚴而逆勢下殺3.1%。亞洲股市方面，美股NASDAQ電子盤仍持續走跌下，日經225指數AI、半導體相關股仍重挫，終場下跌1.79%；韓股同樣因半導體股賣壓湧現，KOSPI終場下跌5.28%。

台股今日受制美國民主黨在期中選舉中勝出，市場擔憂政策不利於AI產業發展，相對電子族群今日成重災區，台積電收在2240元，下跌0.88%，南電、健策、台光電、創意、國巨*、欣興、南亞科等都跌停，奇鋐、鴻勁、日月光投控、緯穎、台達電、川湖等也跌勢沉重，聯發科下挫6.86%，鴻海也跌逾2%。

從29大類股表現來看，玻璃陶瓷類股下跌9.44%、表現最弱，其中台玻跌停；油電燃氣、電子零組件、塑膠類股跌幅也都超過8%，包含台塑化、志聖、聯茂、金像電、禾伸堂、富世達、南亞等多檔個股都跌停。在漲勢族群部分，紡織纖維股上漲1.73%、居家生活股上漲1.44%，運動休閒股上漲1.22%，成為盤面少數亮點。

三大法人動向方面，今日三大法人總計賣超1234.56億元；其中，外資及陸資(不含外資自營商)賣超1024.6億元、連三日賣超逾千億，投信買超225.31億元，自營商賣超435.27億元。

《台股盤後》重挫1612點、日K連四黑，外資賣超千億

Chicago, IL – November 5, 2026– Zacks Director of Research Sheraz Mian says, "Total Q3 earnings for the 372 S&P 500 members that have reported results already are up +24.8% from the same period last year on +14.0% higher revenues."

Q3 Earnings Scorecard: Solid Beats, Upward Revisions & AI Drivers

Note: The following is an excerpt from this week's Earnings Trends report. You can access the full report that contains detailed historical actual and estimates for the current and following periods, please click here>>>

Here are the key points:

The Q3 earnings season has reconfirmed the broad-based strength that we have been seeing in recent reporting cycles. The earnings and revenue growth pace remains strong and broad-based. Even more notably, the revisions trend remains positive, with estimates for 2026 Q4 and full-year 2027 continuing to rise.

Total Q3 earnings for the 372 S&P 500 members that have reported results already are up +24.8% from the same period last year on +14.0% higher revenues, with 82.3% beating EPS estimates and 73.4% beating revenue estimates. The proportion of these 372 index members beating both EPS and revenue estimates (the 'blended' beats percentage) is 64.8%.

For the Tech sector, we now have Q3 results from 68.8% of the sector's market capitalization in the index. Total earnings for these companies are up +33.1% from the same period last year on +28.8% higher revenues, with 83.6% beating EPS estimates and 88.5% beating revenue estimates.

Micron and Nvidia NVDA continue to be material contributors to the Tech sector's growth picture. Excluding Nvidia, Micron, and Alphabet, which enjoyed an outsized gain in the preceding period, Q3 earnings for the rest of the Tech sector would be up +27.7% (vs. +44.2% otherwise).

The Tech Sector Earnings Scorecard

The Tech sector in general and the broader AI basket in particular have been in the eye of the storm in recent weeks, with worries about data center buildout, funding, and permitting in the spotlight. These worries have been weighing on these stocks' performance lately, as the one-month performance chart below of Micron MU, Alphabet GOOGL and the Zacks Tech sector relative to the S&P 500 index shows.

We deliberately used Alphabet and Micron in the chart above as a proxy for the high-quality part of the AI basket. Both companies are particularly relevant from an earnings standpoint, with Micron posting blockbuster results at the start of the Q3 reporting cycle while Alphabet famously failed to impress on that score.

Story Continues

Alphabet is hardly alone in struggling to beat consensus estimates in Q3, as the performance of the Tech sector as a whole on this score has been at best average.

These comparison charts show Q3 EPS and revenue beat percentages for 61 of the 88 S&P 500 companies that have already reported results. As you can see in the left-hand side chart, the Q3 EPS beats percentage for this group is actually tracking a hair below the average for the preceding 20 quarters for this same group of 61 Tech companies.

Looking at Q3 as a whole, combining the actual results that have come out with estimates for the still-to-come Tech companies, total earnings are on track to increase by +44.2% from the same period last year on +35% higher revenues.

The sector's Q3 earnings growth pace drops to +27.7% from +44.2% once contributions from Micron, Alphabet, and Nvidia are excluded.

The Earnings Big Picture

We have shown how Q3 estimates have moved higher since the quarter got underway.

Since the beginning of July, estimates for 2027 have increased for 10 of the 16 Zacks sectors, with Tech, Energy, Finance and Industrials leading the way.

With 74.4% of the S&P 500 results already in, the revisions trend has remained consistently positive. We will keep a close watch on this key metric through the remainder of this reporting cycle.

news.Title: Nucor and Prudential Financial have been highlighted as Zacks Bull and Bear of the Day
news.Content:
For Immediate Release

Chicago, IL – November 5, 2026 – Zacks Equity Research shares Nucor NUE as the Bull of the Day and Prudential Financial PRU as the Bear of the Day. In addition, Zacks Equity Research provides analysis on Advanced Micro Devices, Inc. AMD and NVIDIA Corp. NVDA.

Here is a synopsis of all four stocks:

Bull of the Day:

Nucor , is a Zacks Rank #1 (Strong Buy) and the largest U.S. steel producer, operating scrap-fed electric arc furnace mills nationwide.

The company topped Q3 estimates on record shipments and a sharp pricing rebound, driving shares to all-time highs. With the CEO calling demand the strongest in 31 years, the outlook remains bullish.

About the Company

Based in Charlotte, North Carolina, Nucor operates through three segments. Steel mills are its earnings engine, while steel products include joists, decking, rebar fabrication and building systems. Raw materials cover scrap recycling and direct reduced iron.

The company is valued at $62 billion and has a Forward PE of 12. The stock has Zacks Style Scores of "C" in Value, "B" in Growth, and "B" in Momentum. Nucor has paid 214 consecutive quarterly dividends, with its current $0.56 payout scheduled for November 10.

Earnings Beat

Nucor delivered a strong third quarter, with EPS of $5.80 topping estimates and more than doubling year over year. Revenue reached $11.25 billion, while adjusted EBITDA climbed to $2.28 billion. Mill utilization was 89%, reflecting strong production levels.

The downstream steel products business was the standout, as pricing finally caught up with higher input costs. Segment pricing rose 7% sequentially, expanding EBITDA margins by approximately 200 basis points.

Management expects fourth quarter earnings to be in line with or modestly above Q3, as higher pricing offsets fewer shipping days and planned outages. Full-year steel mill shipment growth is now expected toward the upper end of its 5% to 10% range, with the CEO anticipating a financially stronger 2027.

Demand remains broad-based across heavy equipment, energy, manufacturing, defense and digital infrastructure. Automotive sheet shipments are up 4% despite flat North American vehicle production, while a new GM SUV contract marks a win in a market traditionally dominated by integrated mills.

Growth Projects Ramping

Nucor's West Virginia sheet mill remains on time and budget, with first coils expected by December and utilization targeting 50% by year-end 2027. Its new 500,000-ton automotive galvanizing line in Berkeley began production in October, targeting 50% utilization by Q2 2027 and full run rate by year-end.

Story Continues

The company generated $2.7 billion in free cash flow through the first nine months and returned nearly $1.4 billion to shareholders. Capital spending should fall from roughly $2.5 billion in 2026, supporting stronger cash generation in 2027.

Nucor targets returning at least 40% of net earnings to shareholders and will return excess cash when attractive growth opportunities are unavailable.

Estimates Are Rising

Analysts earnings estimates are going higher across the board.

For the current quarter, estimates have been taken from $4.52 to $5.62 over the last 90 days. That's a jump of 24%.

For the current year, we see a move of 10% higher over that same time frame, with numbers going from $17.86 to $19.61. And the momentum continues for next year, with estimates up 16% over the last 90 days.

Price targets are going higher as well, with Wells Fargo hiking to $305, Barclays to $320 and JP Morgan at $304. Goldman Sachs reiterated its Buy rating, lifting its price target to $335 from $302.

The Technical Take

Since March, the stock has been very strong moving from the $160 area to an all-time high of $287 this week. Investors will now look if there is follow through higher or if a pullback is warranted.

For those looking for entries into the name, let's look at those moving averages:

21-day: $261

50-day: $256

200-day: $225

In Summary

Nucor has a powerful combination of catalysts: record shipments, expanding downstream margins, major growth projects coming online and strong demand across data centers, infrastructure and manufacturing.

With capital spending set to decline,free cash flow poised to climb and the CEO expecting an even stronger 2027, this Zacks Rank #1 (Strong Buy) steel leader has plenty of room to keep building on its momentum.

Bear of the Day:

Prudential Financial , a Zacks Rank #5 (Strong Sell), is one of the largest life insurers and asset managers in the U.S.

Its third-quarter earnings beat expectations, but the headline number masks a deteriorating picture. Revenue missed, earnings declined sharply year over year and Japan remains a growing headache.

With the stock trading near all-time highs after earnings, investors might want to take profits.

Prudential is based in Newark, New Jersey, and operates through three main units:

-PGIM, its global asset manager.

-U.S. businesses spanning retirement, annuities, group insurance and individual life.

-International operations, led by Japan.

Assets under management and administration total $1.81 trillion. The quarterly dividend is $1.40 per share.

The company is valued at $41 billion and has a forward PE of 14. The stock has Zacks Style Scores of "B" in Value, "D" in Growth, and "D" in Momentum.

A Beat on a Lowered Bar

Adjusted operating EPS of $3.77 topped the $3.31 consensus. but fell from $4.26 a year ago. Revenue declined 14.3% year over year to $13.49 billion and missed estimates by 3.35%. Net premiums earned dropped 43% to $5.89 billion. Adjusted book value per share edged up to $102.39 from $99.25.

Management was clear about what held the quarter back: lower Japan earnings more than offset solid results in PGIM and the U.S. businesses.

Shares moved 5% higher after the report.

The Japan Problem Isn't Going Away

Prudential of Japan voluntarily halted new sales in February after employee misconduct involving inappropriate investment solicitations. In April, the company extended that pause to November 5. It estimated a 2026 pretax earnings hit of $525 million to $575 million and about $1 billion in total including 2027. It also withdrew its 5% to 8% intermediate-term EPS growth target.

The regulator has since taken the decision out of management's hands. In October, Japan's Financial Services Agency barred Prudential of Japan from new business until January 31, 2027. It also partially suspended Gibraltar Life's captive Life Consultant sales channel.

Management still describes the broader Japan platform as resilient, but Gibraltar had been carved out of the original suspension. Even after sales resume, the ramp-up costs and lost business will weigh on 2027.

Estimates Moving Lower

Estimate revisions were trending lower heading into the report. The current quarter consensus sits at $3.03 per share, and the full-year number is $13.51. The longer Japan freeze, the Gibraltar restrictions and the earnings lost to divestitures point to more cuts ahead.

Investors need to keep an eye on these numbers going forward, especially to justify the up move after the print.

Technicals

The chart looks good, as the stock is trading near all-time highs. The issue here is that whenever PUR hits the $120-30 level, it's sold off. Considering the issues spelled out below, investors should look to take profits and enter at lower levels.

The 50-day MA is at $115, while the 200-day is $109.

Annuity sales and PGIM flows are moving in the right direction, and a 4%-plus dividend yield will tempt income investors. But the Japan remediation keeps getting longer and wider, revenue is shrinking, the growth target is gone and divestitures are cutting into the earnings base.

Until estimates stop falling, Prudential is a stock to avoid.

AMD Stock: Buy, Hold or Sell After 97% AI Data Center Growth?
