news.Title: 南亞科：公司10/1起變動會計估計事項，將使115年度折舊費用增加約24.38億元
news.Content:
公開資訊觀測站重大訊息公告

(2408)南亞科-本公司自115年10月1日起變動會計估計事項

1.董事會決議日期:115/11/04

2.變動之性質:變動會計估計事項

3.變動之理由:依「證券發行人財務報告編製準則」第6條及「國際會計準則」第16號公報之規定，企業應定期檢視資產之耐用年限，以合理反映資產未來經濟效益。

本公司經委託中華徵信所企業股份有限公司重新評估20奈米製程部分機器設備之耐用年限後，自115年10月1日起調整該機器設備之耐用年限為6年，並經簽證會計師出具複核意見書。

4.改用新會計政策追溯適用之變更期間:不適用

5.會計變動前一年度影響項目與實際影響數:無

6.會計變動前一年度期初保留盈餘之實際影響數:無

7.會計年度開始日後始變動會計政策或會計估計事項之合理性及必要性:本公司依據20奈米製程部分機器設備之實際使用狀況並參考同業經驗，評估後認為該機器設備之實際可使用年限因技術迭代迅速、產品生命週期縮短，使設備之經濟年限不及原訂定耐用年限，致產生之經濟效益減少，應重新評估其耐用年限。

8.影響數之決定在實務上不可行者，其追溯適用不可行之原因、會計變動如何適用及何時開始適用之說明:不適用

9.影響數之決定在實務上不可行者，會計師對會計變動前一年度查核意見之影響表示之意見:不適用

10.會計師就合理性逐項分析表示之意見:依會計師出具之複核意見書，並未發現有重大不合理之處。

11.獨立董事表示反對或保留之意見:不適用

12.因應措施:無

13.其他應敘明事項:此估計變動將使115年度折舊費用增加約新台幣24.38億元。

news.Title: 「藍潮」籠罩！華爾街警惕選後標普兩位數回檔風險　四大族群重新定價
news.Content:
美國期中選舉可能成為年底美股行情的重要轉捩點。隨著初步結果顯示民主黨將橫掃，華爾街正緊急重估政治格局變化對企業獲利、產業監管與財政路徑的衝擊，因市場在投票前未充分計入「藍潮」全面獲勝的可能性。

沃爾夫研究公司美國政策與政治事務主管Tobin Marcus表示，投資者對民主黨全面勝選表現出「雖不情願但勉強接受」的態度，但實際倉位並未真正反映。該公司對逾百名機構投資者的調查顯示，市場並未針對任何一種選舉結果建立明顯集中押注。

摩根大通預估，若掀起「藍潮」，標普500指數短期可能下跌約0.5%，而美股股指期貨周二(3日)跌幅甚至超出這一預期，但把時間拉長，歷史數據其實偏多。自1980年代初以來，每次期中選舉結束一年後，標普都漲，但今年特別之處在於：選前指數已累積兩位數漲幅，樂觀預期提前消化。

BTIG首席市場技術分析師Jonathan Krinsky指出，期中選舉年份標普通常會在下半年出現平均14%回撤，而今年選前並未「先跌」，因此選後反而走出反向走勢的機率更高。

若民主黨擴大影響力，資料中心建設可能面臨更嚴格限制。華盛頓分析公司分析師Rob Rains表示，這將強化各州近期對AI基建的謹慎信號，德州則是關鍵觀察之所在，若共和黨遭翻盤，短期將引發市場不安。

高盛認為，民主黨國會恐限制資料中心稅收優惠，但在全美推出建設暫停令的機率不高，摩根大通則提醒，即便限制AI的法案過關，也難跨過川普的否決權，建議科技股回檔時可逢低買進，但情緒面上，AI類股仍是最先承壓的對象。

軍工股面臨國防開支增速受限的擔憂。富國銀行分析師Alex Sagal指出，除非兩黨就「國防+健保」打包擴支達成共識，否則實際支出成長將被壓縮，不過產業獲利前景仍「穩定至溫和向好」。

醫療保健則可能是相對受益方。Marcus將醫療稱為選後「最受關注的領域」，民主黨擬恢復《平價醫療法案》增強保費補貼，恐撤銷部分醫療補助改革。

Argent Capital基金經理人Jed Ellerbroek, Jr.認為，醫療股近期走強，既有反AI交易切換，也有對民主黨接管國會的樂觀定價。

金融族群壓力回歸。Evercore ISI分析師Matthew Aks指出，民主黨需要在「降低生活成本」上拿出成果，信用卡利率上限、銀行收費監管可能重回桌面；而川普具民粹傾向，不排除在個別議題上與民主黨合流，逼出法案讓其簽字或動用否決權，藉機爭奪政治籌碼。

但比國會兩黨博弈更直接的變數則是地緣政治衝突。川普選前暫緩對伊朗大規模打擊，但選後重啟軍事行動機率仍在。若衝突升級，能源股跑贏，大盤承壓。

GasBuddy石油分析主管Patrick De Haan警告，本月感恩節前油價可能進一步上行，而AAA數據顯示全美汽油均價已年增近40%。Evercore ISI給出最悲觀情景：若川普在1月新國會就職前對伊動武、油價飆升，標普500年底恐出現雙位數回檔，下探至6800點。

整體來看，期中選舉結束不等於不確定性消失，美國國內是AI監管與財政僵局，國外是美伊戰爭與油價衝擊，華爾街接下來要回答的不是「藍潮會不會來」，而是「潮水退去後，哪類資產還能站在岸上」。

news.Title: 盤後／美大選催化　台股盤中跌1451點戰犯還有它
news.Content:
台股今（4）日早盤跳空開高，一度上漲約434點，最高來到43,741.5點，不過隨美國期中選舉開票初期，在野民主黨呈現明顯優勢，美股期指也由漲轉為重跌，拖累台股9時30分過後翻黑。10時過後，日、韓股市進一步重挫近4%，台股跌勢同步擴大，盤中一度大跌1,451.72點，最低下探41,855.82點。 12時過後，隨日、韓股市及美股期指反彈，台股跌幅大幅收斂，終場下跌358.63點，收在42,948.91點，成交值1兆1,148.21億元。

美企財報報捷 債市警訊浮現

國際市場方面，美國重要AI指標股超微（AMD）與美超微（Super Micro Computer）公布財報，表現優於市場預期，盤後股價一度大漲超過7%，帶動亞洲市場開盤時美股期指延續前一交易日反彈走勢。 不過，隨美國期中選舉結果陸續出爐，美股期指突然轉跌，亞洲市場午盤前，那斯達克期指一度下跌超過2%，直到12時30分過後才開始出現明顯反彈。 美國公司債市場也出現風險警訊。

根據《MarketWatch》3日報導，CCC級與B級公司債殖利率差距，已從9月下旬的8個百分點擴大至超過9個百分點。 歷史上，當這項利差觸及8個百分點時，標普500指數曾經處於或隨後進入較大幅度回落。不過，由於訊號出現時間差異甚大，無法據此判定股市即將重挫。 FactSet資料顯示，過去至少有五次利差達到8個百分點，分別出現在1999年、2000年、2008年、2015年及2020年。其中，部分訊號是在股市已經大幅下跌後才出現，另一些則領先後續跌勢。

網銀異常轉帳 資安概念走強

盤面焦點方面，雲端與資安概念股受到永豐銀行疑似異常轉帳事件消息帶動，今日再度明顯轉強。東捷資訊（6697）、力新（5202）、訊達（6140）及驊宏資（6148）盤中攻上漲停，伊雲谷（6689）一度逼近漲停，大世科（8099）盤中上漲約7%。 永豐銀行3日傳出疑似異常轉帳事件，客戶存款遭遠端轉走4,000萬元，金管會證實有419人受害。台灣資訊安全協會（TWISA）監事鄭加海指出，這起事件值得關注的不只是網銀程式異常，更在於銀行整體交易授權、系統變更管理及內部風險控管是否有效。

銅箔基板抗跌 二線板卡齊揚

PCB族群今日表現相對強勢，銅箔基板與玻纖材料相關個股中，富喬（1815）盤中一度逼近漲停，南亞（1303）、德宏（5475）一度上漲約4%至5%。 銅箔基板（CCL）三雄方面，聯茂（6213）盤中一度大漲約8%，台光電（2383）及台燿（6274）也一度上漲約5%。 二線板卡概念股則在麗臺（2465）再度攻上漲停帶動下走強。受到超微財報優於預期激勵，與超微關係密切的華擎（3515）、撼訊（6150）陸續攻上漲停，承啟（2425）盤中也一度大漲約7%。

news.Title: 〈台股盤後〉盤中大怒神權值股回神急拉千點 終場仍跌358點失守4萬3
news.Content:
台股今(4)日受美國期中選舉前觀望態度濃厚影響，加上日、韓股雙雙重挫、台幣續貶，電子、金融、傳產同步走跌，早盤由紅翻黑，一度重挫超過1,450點，摜破4萬2千點關卡，盤中隨著電子權值股回神，大盤急拉逾千點，資安、機器人、塑化股多檔逆勢上揚，指數終場下跌358.63點或0.83%，收42,948.91點，日K連收5黑，成交量放大至 1.1 兆元。

電子權值股方面，台積電(2330-TW)開高走低，終場跌1.53%或35元，失守2,300元、收2,260元；聯發科(2454-TW)盤中跌逾半根停板，尾盤逆勢上揚漲1.09%；其他權值股漲跌互見，台達電(2308-TW)跌3.94%、日月光投控(3711-TW)漲1.79%、鴻海(2317-TW)跌2.24%、聯電(2303-TW)漲2.43%。

盤面上，傳產雖多數震盪走跌，但盤中包括資安、機器人族群逆勢上揚，塑化股盤中則堅挺翻紅。

近期電商服務商發生重大資安事件，加上永豐銀超過419名網銀用戶遭盜領，資安股連續2日表現強勢，包括訊達(6140-TW)、仁大資訊(7767-TW)、華經(2468 -TW)、東捷資訊(6697-TW)、力新(5202-TW)等族群聯袂亮燈衝上漲停板。

機器人概念股的陽程(3498-TW)、大量(3167-TW)漲半根停板，信邦(3023-TW)、百德(4563-TW)漲3-4%。

塑化股中的中華化(1727-TW)、台塑化(6505-TW)、南亞(1303-TW)漲超過2%，國喬(1312-TW)、台化(1326-TW)漲幅超過1%以上。

法人表示，大盤近期跌幅已多，從融資餘額資料觀察，短線融資水位過高，搭配市場多殺多、停損賣壓全面出籠，若今日盤後顯示，融資減幅達4、500億元左右，籌碼就應該已到了底部，未來2、3日過後台股有望展開反彈力道行情，提醒投資人可以承接遭錯殺的業績績優股，逢低進行布局操作。

news.Title: 台日韓股戲劇性反攻V轉 投顧董座揭2原因：美選舉明朗、斷頭賣壓釋出
news.Content:
台日韓股市今（4）日上演戲劇性反攻，台股盤中一度重挫逾1400點，失守4萬2千點，午盤後隨美股期指及韓股同步急拉，終場跌幅收斂至358.63點，收在42,948.91點，成交金額放大至1.1兆元以上。第一金投顧董事長黃詣庭分析，美國期中選舉結果逐漸明朗，加上總統川普發表接受選舉結果、願意與民主黨合作的談話，化解市場疑慮，帶動美股期指與亞洲股市反彈；台股連日下殺後，部分融資斷頭賣壓釋出，也有助於盤勢回穩。

黃詣庭指出，台股早盤開高後，隨美國期中選舉開票結果陸續出爐，市場緊張情緒升高，碰上美國那斯達克期指及韓股跌幅擴大，台股也跟著重挫。不過，中午12時左右，選情逐漸底定，依當時開票情況，民主黨取得參議院主導權的態勢已相當明確，眾議院雖仍在開票，但依原先民調及關鍵州結果判斷，民主黨同樣具有優勢，市場開始消化國會版圖變化，美股期指隨即快速拉升，帶動亞洲股市回穩。

對於市場為何由恐慌轉向反彈，黃詣庭分析，關鍵在於「選舉所帶來的不確定性下降」。當國會與行政部門由不同政黨掌握，川普未來若要透過立法推動較激進的政策，難度將明顯提高，成為市場重新評價風險的因素。此外，台股歷經昨日及今日盤中急跌，研判已有相當程度的內資斷頭賣壓出籠，籌碼快速清洗，也有助於醞釀技術面反彈。

不過，黃詣庭提醒，單日出現長下影線，仍不足以確認落底，投資人無須躁進。後續可觀察明日台股震盪後，能否再度留下下影線，且成交量未出現失控情況，若底部區連續出現長下影線，將有助於確認盤勢轉折；另一項觀察指標，則是反彈能否收復昨日整根大黑K棒的跌幅，再評估分批進場布局。

展望短線，黃詣庭表示，接下來仍須留意本周五美國非農就業數據，以及11月10日前後的通膨數據、重要企業財報與國際外交進展。中東情勢同樣牽動市場信心，尤其川普在選後對伊朗採取和談或擴大軍事行動，均可能影響短線投資情緒。在國際局勢仍存變數、台股尚未出現更明確落底訊號前，建議先以觀望、保守態度因應。

馮萱榕／財經特派記者，主跑財政部、電腦通路、觀光餐飲等

news.Title: 台股2天狂瀉近2千點！專家曝「這族群」面臨斷頭
news.Content:
財經中心／彭期正報導

台股近日大盤指數劇烈震盪。繼昨（3）日狂瀉1612點、創下台股史上第七大單日跌幅後，今（4）日盤勢依舊欲振乏力，盤中一度重挫逾1400點，尾盤跌幅收斂，最終下跌358.63點，收在42,948.91點。短短2天，台股累計蒸發近2000點，連續的血腥殺盤不僅讓股民叫苦連天，知名財經專家「股魚」都示警，「四貸同堂」槓桿族群承受的壓力比持有現股者更大。

不用主管機關出手就「被迫降槓桿」！股魚：四貸同堂面臨斷頭邊緣

股魚於昨日大盤慘跌時在 臉書粉專發文直言 ：「台股下跌 1600 點，四貸同堂的投資人壓力山大！」他指出，隨著股市狂跌，不用主管機關出手降溫，市場就已經「被迫降槓桿」了。股魚進一步強調，在這種劇烈拉回的行情中，持有現股的投資人固然壓力巨大，但「融資開槓桿的壓力更大」，承受的風險呈翻倍成長。所謂的「四貸同堂」，是指投資人同時利用房貸、車貸、信貸及股票質押等工具擴張信用來炒股。金管會為此推動跨業信用資料查詢機制，意圖遏止過度擴張信用。銀行端自10月31日起實施，券商端則於11月2日上路。

股魚示警四貸同堂的投資人壓力山大，股民紛紛留言「好慘，一年被收割兩次，根本是恐怖片！」（圖／民視新聞資料照）

網悲鳴「1年被收割2次像恐怖片」！存股、現股族淡定：準備加碼

股魚的貼文一出，讓大批股民淚奔，紛紛留言「好慘，一年被收割兩次，根本是恐怖片！」、「今年這兩波下跌，應該讓很多人今年獲利都歸零了」；也有人點出高槓桿者的慘況：「融資壓力真的最大，但感覺今天融資還是打死不退」、「不跌多一點，融資就居高不下」。相較之下，現股與空手的股民則顯得相對淡定，紛紛留言：「還好我都持有現股，繼續擺著」、「空手無傷」、「存股派準備加碼」，甚至有人悲觀預警：「驚什麼，這才剛開始而已」。

news.Title: 聯電、台塑四寶撐盤！台股強拉千點下影線 收跌358點
news.Content:
台股今（4）日開高走低，盤中重挫逾1400點，下探41855點低點後，在權值股急拉下，跌幅迅速收斂拉出逾千點的下影線，尾盤以42948點作收，下跌358點，跌幅0.83%，成交量爆出1.11兆元大量。

權值股部分，台積電跌35元，收2260元，下跌1.53%，聯發科、日月光、大立光上漲逾1%、聯電更強彈2.43%；千金股中，緯穎收漲0.85%，台光電收漲3.64%，創意漲4.71%，群聯也有1.18%的漲幅。

進一步觀察強勢族群，PCB、被動元件族群輪流點火，PCB中，富喬、敬鵬、銘旺科、晟鈦、聯致、榮科、聯茂皆有2~4%的漲幅，同泰更逆勢漲停亮燈；被動元件部分，金山電收漲停來到133元，凱美、大毅、禾伸堂、光頡、日電貿也有1~3%的漲幅。

台塑四寶也有不錯的表現，台塑化收漲2.85%，來到97.6元，其餘三寶雖一度翻黑下跌，但在午盤過後強彈翻紅，南亞收276.5元，上漲逾2%，台塑上漲0.58%，台化也有1.17%的漲幅。

news.Title: 〈美國期中選舉〉「藍色浪潮」料橫掃國會 華爾街下一階段走向何方？
news.Content:
美國期中選舉初步開票結果顯示民主黨表現強勁，市場對民主黨橫掃國會兩院「藍色浪潮」(Blue Wave)的押注急劇升溫。預測平台 Polymarket 上民主黨同時掌控國會兩院的機率衝上 99%，Kalshi 顯示民主黨贏得眾議院與參議院的機率分別達 99% 與 98%。

選前華爾街的主流定價多建立在「分裂政府」(Divided Government)情景之上，當國會控制權轉向藍潮，全球金融市場隨即迎來即時調整。

選情震盪與華爾街資產即時反應

選舉結果公布初期的資產價格變化，呈現出清晰的結構性特徵，而非無差别的避險殺盤。美股期貨出現分化下挫，其中科技股集中的那斯達克 100 指數期貨重挫 2%，標普 500 指數期貨下跌約 0.9%，道瓊指數期貨僅微跌 0.3%。

與此同時，美元指數日內跌幅超過 0.5%，美國 10 年期公債殖利率則下行約 7 個基點至4.89%。

華爾街分析指出，資產價格的重估指向了兩大核心邏輯：一方面，國會分裂或財政約束預期對公債形成利多；另一方面，民主黨若全面掌權，對人工智慧(AI)與科技供應鏈政策的監管審查恐顯著收緊，直接對科技股評價造成壓頭。

92%勝率紀錄面臨考驗

歷史統計數據為選後股市表現提供了強勁的正面支撐，據德意志銀行(Deutsche Bank) 統計，自 1946 年二戰以來，標普 500 指數於期中選舉後 12 個月內 20 次全數上漲，平均漲幅達 14.4%；若將時間跨度拉回 1930 年，24 次選舉中有 22 次上漲，勝率高達 92%。

金融機構 Edward Jones 的數據指出，自 1970 年以來，標普 500 在期中選舉後 1 個月平均上漲 1.7%，選後 6 個月平均漲幅達 15.5%。

摩根士丹利補充，在共和黨總統執政期間，若期中選舉後國會呈現分裂狀態，標普 500 隨後一年的平均漲幅高達 23%，高於民主黨掌控兩院時的 16%。Principal Asset Management 市場策略師 Magdalena Ocampo 表示，儘管投票前後市場難免波動，但隨著政治不確定性消退，焦點終將回歸經濟基本面。

FHN Financial 首席經濟學家 Chris Low 分析，政治僵局降低了重大政策變動的風險，創造出可預測的環境，有利於企業進行長期投資與提升獲利。

然而，德意志銀行與摩根士丹利同時警告，本次市場結構存在顯著例外：當前標普 500 指數的「權重集中度」處於歷史最高水準。 德意志銀行指出，少數幾檔超大市值科技巨頭暴露於 AI 資本支出敘事與潛在監管審查之下，若這些權重股出現回調，恐使這項保持多年的 92% 勝率紀錄面臨被打破的風險。

華爾街主要機構與專家觀點

各家機構對於選後 12 個月市場大方向仍多持正面態度，但在短期波動路徑與關鍵催化劑上存在分歧：

Evercore ISI 策略師 Julian Emanuel提出了精細的情景分析框架。在「國會分裂且無爭議」的基準情景下，標普 500 年終目標價為 7,750 點；若民主黨橫掃且發生選舉爭議，年末目標下修至 7,650 點，並視初期下跌為買入良機；若出現「藍潮 + 選舉爭議 + 地緣政治衝突升級」的三重疊加極端情景，標普 500 可能拉回逾 10% 至 6,800 點，此時則不宜盲目逢低承接。

摩根士丹利首席美股策略師 Mike Wilson採取「先經歷波動，再進行買入」的立場。他認為期中選舉、AI 支出壓力與流動性收緊等出清事件，可能將標普 500 推低至約 7,100 點(回撤約 9%)，但隨著事件平息，指數將朝 8,000 點回升。Wi

news.Title: 《美股主題週報》航太國防與太空經濟—AVAV、GD、RKLB
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-11-04 14:17:53 數位內容中心 發佈

AeroVironment（AVAV.US）

11月2日，AeroVironment公布Leonardo DRS獲選支援美國陸軍30千瓦LOCUST X3雷射系統生產，分包涵蓋整合技術、電力與環控支援。這顯示該反無人機定向能武器已由原型驗證推進至量產準備。

Lockheed Martin（LMT.US）

10月29日，Lockheed Martin取得美國空軍6.94億美元合約，生產高超音速ARRW飛彈系統，並帶動阿拉巴馬州Troy廠擴建。資料指出當地生產空間預計增至3倍，反映公司正提前布局高超音速武器量產能力。

General Dynamics（GD.US）

10月30日，General Dynamics揭露本季潛艦接單為核心亮點，新增5艘Columbia-class Build II與9艘Virginia-class Block VI合約，合計716億美元。這使公司Q3新訂單接近990億美元，並將在手訂單推升至歷史新高。

Rocket Lab（RKLB.US）

11月2日，Rocket Lab完成第99次Electron任務，替日本iQPS再送一顆衛星入軌，支援其合成孔徑雷達（SAR）星座部署。報導並提到後續仍有8次iQPS發射任務待執行，顯示客戶採取連續部署模式。

news.Title: 華邦電賺翻股價卻跌停？  專家喊「派對未結束」 大摩最新目標價出爐
news.Content:
記憶體大廠華邦電（2344）近日公布第三季財，EPS高達7.58元，前三季累計 15.32元，毛利率更衝上70.6%，不過股民並未買單，華邦電3日股價連慘遭打入跌停，今（4）日更是觸及132.5元波段新低，連兩日累積跌幅超過16%。

對此，投資專家「股人阿勳」分析，市場不買單的理由是「記憶體漲價太兇」，就連蘋果都開始承受不了成本壓力，必須透過調漲產品售價轉嫁消費者，一旦終端需求受到影響，上游記憶體的拉貨動能自然可能放緩。

股人阿勳補充，雖然這個擔憂有道理，但現在宣布派對結束恐怕還太早，畢竟華邦電也在法說提到，記憶體供給仍然吃緊，甚至預期2027年可能比今年更缺貨。

不過值得一提的是，華邦電第三季獲利暴增，很大一部分來自記憶體價格上漲，而不是出貨量同步暴增。股人阿勳認為，這代表未來即使記憶體價格沒有下跌，只要漲價速度放緩，獲利成長就可能跟著降溫。「投資景氣循環股最怕什麼？不是公司開始虧錢，而是公司還在大賺特賺，股價卻已經提前反映下一輪景氣下滑。」

股人阿勳直言，比起華邦電今年能賺多少，所以他更在意的是，在目前這麼好的獲利下，明、後年還能維持多少？「派對不一定結束，但當所有人都覺得酒喝不完的時候，反而要開始注意誰準備買單了！」

此外，大摩在最新的研究報告中指出，華邦電毛利率來到70.6%，大幅高於大摩預估12.5個百分點；管理層預計第4季將持續成長，但隨著非AI需求趨緩，成長力道也有所收斂。

產能規劃部分，大摩預期高雄廠Module A 2026年底前達到每月2.4 萬至2.5萬片、16nm製程將從約2000片擴至1.6萬片，足以支撐2027年下半年的出貨需求，因此將華邦電的目標價調升至288元，並給予「優於大盤」的評等。

news.Title: 台股又暴挫逾1300點到底怎麼了？觀察這二個跌深反彈指標
news.Content:
台股今(4)日接近午盤跌點再度擴大至超過1300點，其中，護國神山台積電(2330-TW)持續下探7月底以來的低點，最低來到2235元，跌幅超過2%，貢獻台股近400點的跌點，其次還有聯發科(2454-TW)造成逾90點跌點、台達電(2308-TW)75點左右，法人指出，現階段盤勢已進入融資多殺多，只能先等待浮額清洗，而後續觀察融資減幅和外資對期現貨態度，做為醞釀跌深反彈指標。

統一投顧指出，台股技術指標中KD、RSI 低檔鈍化，MACD 維持綠柱體擴大，整體技術面弱勢整理，且進入超跌區，現階段進入融資多殺多，先靜待止跌 K 線出現，後續先觀察融資減幅和外資對期現貨態度，來做為醞釀跌深反彈指標。

尤其櫃買指數盤中跌幅超過5%，並已跌破年線，短線需留意融資多殺多和法人籌碼鬆動。

統一投顧進一步說明，在市場對 AI 前景擔憂的情緒下，外資持續對台股進行提款，本波大盤累計回檔達 13.56%，但融資減幅卻僅 8.19%，顯示浮額清洗尚不完全，不過，過往美國期中選舉選後上漲機率高，等待短期能否醞釀反彈。

元大投顧則分析，美國期中選舉、中東爭端難止、歐洲債務危機，再加上谷歌等大型雲端業者自由現金流量轉負，以及甲骨文再傳舉債籌資建設 AI，多項利空齊聚，市場疑慮陡升，股市抛售潮越演越烈，擁有利差優勢的美元因避險需求而吸引國際熱錢回流，導致今年漲幅領先群國的台股，被外資視為提款機。

隨著美國期中選舉終將落幕，元大投顧認為，首要之務就是做好資金控管， 靜待籌碼面清洗沈澱，而資金充裕者則可開始小額低接全球 AI 一軍。

news.Title: 台股慘崩「好股票大拍賣」 專家曝4檔權值股 反彈第一個噴出
news.Content:
台股跌跌不休，有國家隊之稱的官股行庫加碼也止不住；台股4日盤中又暴跌，接近11點半左右一度跌超過1300點、最低來到4萬1948點，一路失守43K、42K兩個整數關卡。據了解，官股行庫昨逆勢加碼284億元，連續4個交易日站在買方，指數仍然持續下挫。

台積電今最低跌60元、來到2235元；聯發科跌幅超過5.5％、最多跌205元，來到3470元，台達電更一口氣跌逾7％，最低來到1170元。

國泰證期顧問部分析師郭經緯分析，這波跌勢起因是美國科技股財報不如預期，現在又遇上美國期中選舉不確定性，以AI發展來看，郭經緯認為，不是AI生意不好，而是蓋資料中心花錢的速度，比現金賺進來還快，但這不意謂AI泡沫了，大家天天都在用，且用得很開心。

從研究平台觀察，每日Token使用量從7月約10兆，攀升至10月高峰近30兆，短短三個月成長近2倍；郭經緯解讀，這些數據證明AI應用需求持續擴張，還沒泡沫化。所以這波修正比較像AI估值與資金面的壓力測試。

面對台股累計1個月大跌逾7000點，郭經緯表示，這是好股票大拍賣的時刻，是加碼有獲利、持續成長權值好股的好時機；舉例來說，台積電、台達電、聯發科與大立光，分別受惠先進製程、AI電源、TPU客製化晶片與矽光CPO需求，當市場信心回穩，這些有獲利支撐的權值股，有機會成為法人優先回補的對象。

news.Title: 台股血洗1400點！先不要買台積電、聯電 低接鎖定7檔優質股
news.Content:
台股面臨大幅修正賣壓，今（4日）盤中一度下殺超過1300點，跌破42,000點關卡，恐慌性殺盤再現，若以技術面黃金切割率來看0.809的低檔支撐下移至41,406點也是短線上重要支撐。資深分析師林友銘則認為，可考慮低接的族群為老AI、記憶體與金融股，外資提款機的權值股與業績帶發酵的族群應該暫時避免。

台股重演7月股災 散戶先不要碰台積電

台股7月時曾下探39,384點，隨後三個月反彈衝上49,968的歷史新高，若黃金切割率來看，台股已經從高點下殺跌破拉回0.618的43,428點，因此接下來的重要支撐是拉回0.809的41,406點。

台股後市面臨更長時間整理的壓力，資深分析師林友銘於理財節目《Catch大錢潮》指出，可留意老AI緯創、和碩、鴻海及廣達，修正後評價回到合理區，外資賣不多，基本面仍具支撐，長線動能不變。

記憶體、老AI可關注 整理時間恐拉長

另外，記憶體與金融股也成為關注焦點，以南亞科、富邦金與中信金為首，林友銘認為，南亞科已率先進入整理型態，金融股則具有殖利率優勢與防禦性，在波動中具有資金停泊效果，適合中長期配置。

相反，林友銘認為應該先觀望「外資提款機」台積電、聯電與聯發科，外資賣壓明顯籌碼面偏弱，且權值佔比高，容易成為調節重心，應該先等待籌碼沉澱，觀察資金動向，若想要押注也應該分批布局。

林友銘也提醒投資人小心業績尚未反映的族群，包括大立光與友達，其題材仍需時間發蕭，追價不如耐心觀察，待量能與基本面同步轉強。

news.Title: 邊緣AI重塑商業版圖 晶片巨頭及新創業者雙軌搶市
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-11-04 12:31:33 新聞中心 發佈

根據DIGITIMES最新研究指出，邊緣AI處理器的應用重心正從過往10 TOPS以下的傳統機器視覺與感測辨識，邁向40 TOPS以上的地端生成式AI與自主機器人等高階應用。DIGITIMES分析師申作昊指出，邊緣運算環境高度受限於散熱空間、功耗預算與記憶體頻寬成本，加上終端作業系統與軟硬體生態高度破碎，以及28/40奈米等成熟製程節點產能擴充有限，促使跨領域手機晶片巨頭、傳統視覺SoC大廠與邊緣AI新創業者，紛紛依據自身主控處理器能力與生態系優勢，展開差異化的產品規格與商業模式布局。

在跨領域行動晶片巨頭方面，申作昊表示，高通(Qualcomm)與聯發科(2454)為減緩智慧型手機本業受市況與記憶體價格波動的影響，近年持續擴大物聯網、車用與邊緣運算業務的多元布局。其中，聯發科智慧裝置平台營收佔比於2026年第3季首度突破5成，高通車用與IoT營收亦持續創下新高。

在邊緣產品規格上，高通憑藉工業級IQ系列、Dragonwing與Cloud AI 100 Ultra，建構出橫跨1 TOPS至700 TOPS以上的中高階算力版圖；聯發科過往Genio系列多聚焦15 TOPS以下輕量應用，2026年推出突破50 TOPS的Genio Pro，初試中高階市場水溫，並預計於2027年推出算力翻倍的新品。

在傳統視覺晶片大廠與邊緣AI新創業者的競合方面，申作昊認為，晶片是否具備「自有主控核心（Host CPU）」，已成為產品型態與商業模式分化關鍵。瑞昱(2379)、瑞芯微與安霸(Ambarella)等傳統視覺大廠，憑藉成熟的客戶基礎與影像訊號處理器（ISP）生態，持續固守「獨立作業SoC」發展主軸；SiMa.ai、愛芯元智、耐能智慧、Hailo、Axelera AI與DEEPX等新創業者則普遍採取輕資產策略，2025年後推出的中高階新品多以標準M.2或PCIe協同加速卡形式，搭載於樹莓派、x86工業電腦（IPC）或Arm主控平台上，大幅降低工業客戶跨平台軟體遷移的導入門檻。

此外，為解決邊緣軟體生態破碎的痛點並加速終端導入，部分邊緣AI晶片業者進一步攜手台灣IPC與EMS夥伴，向下整合推出預載完整軟體套件的「Edge Box」準系統，並分化出多路視覺分析盒與本地生成式AI盒兩大品類，以自有品牌標準品進行應用示範。對台廠而言，這股晶片業者向系統端延伸的趨勢，也為IPC與EMS業者帶來新的合作商機。

在產業整併方面，2025～2026年邊緣AI市場掀起一波購併與策略投資潮，包括恩智浦(NXP)收購Kinara、微芯(Microchip)收購Hailo，以及三星電子(Samsung Electronics)重金投資DEEPX等案例。申作昊指出，這顯示新創業者正試圖依附老牌MCU與代工巨頭的生態系，全球邊緣AI硬體聯盟的合作版圖也將隨之重塑。

news.Title: 台股重挫外資匯出壓境　新台幣大貶盤中觸及32.9元關卡
news.Content:
（中央社記者潘姿羽台北2026年11月4日電）儘管美國費半反彈，台股仍面臨沉重賣壓，接近中午，跌點擴大至逾1300點，外資匯出浪潮不停歇，新台幣貶勢加劇，盤中最低觸及32.9元、重貶1.4角。

美國費城半導體指數反彈2.63%，激勵台股開盤走揚，但隨後賣壓湧現，台股指數翻黑且跌點持續擴大，最低摔至41899點，暴跌超過1300點，失守42000點大關。

外資匯出壓力沉重，新台幣貶勢難止，今天以32.79元開盤後一度呈現偏弱整理，但隨台股崩跌，匯價急速走弱，最低觸及32.9元、貶值1.4角。

匯銀人士分析，外資匯出狂潮使新台幣貶勢洶洶，接下來匯市將上演外資與出口商的攻防戰，若出口商積極進場拋匯，新台幣可望於32.9元附近獲得支撐，但若台股跌勢持續擴大，外資賣股匯出殺紅眼，新台幣急貶摜破32.9元後，下一步恐將測試33元整數大關。

news.Title: 路透調查：美元明年走勢偏貶 但強勢風險尚存
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-11-04 12:11:17 李彥瑾 發佈

今年以來，美元表現相當強勁，但外匯分析師普遍對後市持謹慎看空態度。路透社最新調查顯示，多數專家預期未來一年美元將趨向貶值，不過，基於美國經濟成長穩健、通膨居高不下，加上聯準會（Fed）可能再度升息，美元仍有維持強勢的空間。

路透社於10月30日至11月3日進行的調查顯示，66名受訪分析師的預測中位數顯示，歐元兌美元將從目前約1.12美元的水準，於未來3個月、6個月及一年分別升至1.13、1.14及1.16美元，相當於美元未來一年對歐元貶值約3.4%。

不過，在回答額外問題的30名分析師中，有17人認為，未來3個月美元表現可能比預期強勢，反映美元後市存在高度不確定性。

美銀外匯策略師Alex Cohen指出，美國經濟成長強勁、通膨持續高於Fed的2%目標，可能支撐美元維持強勢更長時間。目前聯邦基金期貨市場預測，Fed將於12月、2027年3月各升息一碼。

美國期中選舉方面，Cohen認為，民主黨選情優勢已大致反映在市場價格上；若共和黨意外保住參、眾兩院控制權，則可能帶動美股、美債殖利率及美元同步走高。

此外，美伊戰事持續推升油價及通膨風險。法國東方匯理銀行分析師Valentin Marinov表示，若中東衝突再度升級，美元兼具高利率與避險屬性，可能吸引資金流入，帶動美元走強。

news.Title: 〈台股開盤〉開高漲逾400點隨即震盪翻黑 CCL、機器人股撐場
news.Content:
美股費半3日收紅，台股今（4）日以43,449.45點開出，上漲141.91點，開盤後一度升至43,741.54點、漲434點，而在台積電由紅翻黑，指數漲幅收斂，一度翻黑下跌，指數在平盤間震盪。早盤估量8852億元。

主要權值股漲跌互見。台積電 (2330-TW) 以2,320元開出，上漲25元，隨後回落至平盤附近、小跌約0.11%；聯發科 (2454-TW) 漲約0.34%，日月光投控 (3711-TW) 漲約1.70%。台達電 (2308-TW)、鴻海 (2317-TW) 與廣達 (2382-TW) 則分別跌約1.38%、1.32%與1.52%。

PCB與銅箔基板股表現相對強勢，聯茂 (6213-TW) 漲約6.42%，台光電 (2383-TW) 漲約5.40%，台燿 (6274-TW) 漲約3.44%，金像電 (2368-TW) 也漲約1.91%。

機器人族群同步走揚，東台 (4526-TW) 上漲2.6元、漲4.74%，暫報57.5元；上銀 (2049-TW) 漲約2.77%，盟立 (2464-TW) 漲約1.43%。

資訊服務股部分個股續強，華經 (2468-TW) 大漲9.95%，暫報60.8元；大世科 (8099-TW) 漲約3.16%。

統一證券指出，台股整體技術面弱勢整理，且進入超跌區，現階段進入融資多殺多，靜待止跌K線出現，後續觀察融資減幅及外資期現貨態度，視為醞釀跌深反彈指標。OTC指數跌破年線，短線仍需留意融資多殺多及法人籌碼鬆動。

news.Title: 美國期中選情帶崩亞股！日股慘跌2000點 台股匯大暴殺
news.Content:
美國大選部分地區開票結果陸續出爐，市場避險情緒快速升溫，金融市場震盪擴大，亞洲股市同步承壓。日本股市結束假期後今（4）日恢復交易，指數補跌盤中重挫逾2000點，科技股賣壓湧現；台北股匯市也出現劇烈波動，加權指數盤中一度失守4萬3千點關卡，下探42955.54點，新台幣兌美元匯率也走弱，盤中貶逾1角，報32.79元。

亞洲科技股普遍走跌，日本科技股賣壓尤其明顯。鎧俠股價盤中下跌13%，軟銀集團下跌7.1%，半導體測試設備商愛德萬測試也下跌8.1%，顯示市場資金態度轉趨保守，連帶使台灣掛牌日股ETF共計11檔也補跌，目前以中信日本半導體下挫逾6%最慘、台新日本半導體也下跌逾5%。

韓股目前跌逾1%，記憶體雙雄領跌，SK海力士一度跌逾4%，三星跌3%。

新台幣今天以32.79元開盤，貶3分，隨後跌勢加重貶逾1角。由於近期美國科技股賣壓延續，外資持續調節台股，3日更賣超逾千億元，導致短線新台幣持續偏弱。

隨著美國大選開票結果陸續揭曉，多家媒體預測民主黨奪下眾院控制權，並在參院多州領先共和黨，美國總統川普恐跛腳，市場持續關注選情發展及其對全球金融市場的影響，亞洲股市短線波動也受到資金動向牽動。

news.Title: 《日股早盤》關注美國選舉 日經指數下跌3.56%
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-11-04 10:34:44 黃文章 發佈

日經指數週三早盤下跌，美國期中選舉開票持續進行，市場傳出在上下兩院選舉中，對人工智慧（AI）監管態度較為積極的在野黨民主黨目前占據優勢，導致AI及半導體相關股票賣壓增加。

日經225指數4日早盤收盤(台北時間上午10點30分)下跌3.56%或2,246.50點，暫收60,835.36點。東證股價指數(TOPIX)早盤收盤下跌2.49%或98.01點，暫收3,832.27點。

就類股表現來看，截至早盤收盤為止，空運業（2.94%）、陸運業（1.07%）、不動產業（1.07%）漲幅較大，跌幅較大的類股為非鐵金屬（-6.89%）、礦業（-5.35%）、石油業（-5.32%）。

日經新聞報導，市場人士普遍擔憂，如果民主黨取得美國國會多數席次，進一步強化AI監管，可能妨礙美國大型雲端服務業者（Hyperscalers）持續投入巨額資金進行AI基礎建設。

日本國內一家證券公司的策略師表示：「如果民主黨成為美國國會多數黨，並加強AI監管，可能對大型雲端服務業者的鉅額投資形成阻礙。過去一直受惠於相關投資擴張的日本企業，將因此面臨逆風。」

news.Title: 開市補跌！日股狂瀉2900點 鎧俠跌13% 日股ETF最重跌7%
news.Content:
中午12點25分更新

日股昨（3）日休市，逃過亞股大逃殺，但今（4）早開市後難逃補跌命運，日經225指一度狂洩逾2900點、跌幅破4.6%，其中記憶體大廠、全球第二大NAND廠鎧俠重挫13%，連帶在台灣掛牌日股ETF共計11檔也跟進補跌，只有反向及房地產類沒跌，其中以中信日本半導體（00954）下挫逾7.44%最重、台新日本半導體也跌逾6.7%，2倍槓桿的富邦日本正2（00640L）也跌近7%。

日股昨天因日本國定假日「文化日（文化の日）」。東京證券交易所（TSE）與日本交易所集團（JPX）將11月3日列為年度休市日，因此逃過一天股災，但今天一早就出現跳水急殺的補跌走勢，截至10點左右，一度跌到61,060.26點，較前一天收盤下跌了2021點，跌幅超過3.2%。

其中日股重要指標股如全球第二大NAND記憶體大廠鎧俠股價下跌13%，AI控股龍頭軟銀集團下跌7.1%，愛德萬測試下跌8.1%，讓日股今早賣壓沈重。

中午過後日股跌幅更擴大到4.6%，日經225 一度跌逾2900點到60181.03點，下午收盤前將進行6萬點保衛點。

韓股今日再跌4%，綜合指數最低下探5421點，累計加昨天也下跌了近8%之多。

台股掛牌的日股相關ETF共計有13檔之多，其中包括連結指數或是半導體、房地產、商社或龍頭等，今早除了反向外，12檔全數下跌，其中尤其以日本半導體相關ETF的中信日本半導體下跌7.44%最重，其次是台新日本半導體的6.7%。

還有富邦日本正2因是2倍槓桿，表彰日股跌幅2倍，今早有近7%跌幅也不輕，日股ETF昨天普遍跌幅不重，今日才開始補跌，其他日股ETF普遍僅下跌集中在2~3%跌幅。日本不動產甚至一度有紅盤，反向的富邦日本反1（00641R）有1%的漲幅。

news.Title: 川普幕僚曝「已做最壞打算」 美期貨下跌 台日韓股也翻黑
news.Content:
美國期中選舉開票牽動全球金融市場！美國總統川普雖期待共和黨選情優於民調預期，但幕僚已坦言做好最壞打算。隨著部分地區陸續開票，市場不確定性升高，外匯專家李其展指出，美股期貨出現快速下跌，韓股由紅翻黑，日經指數跌幅擴大至逾3％，新台幣早盤也貶1角貶破32.86元，外資似乎持續調節持股。台股今（4）日早盤一度反彈逾400點，隨後卻由紅翻黑，市場避險情緒升溫。

川普幕僚坦言已做最壞打算

美國期中選舉於美東時間3日登場，各州投票站陸續關閉並展開開票。根據美媒報導，川普在白宮與內閣成員及核心盟友共同關注選情，白宮周邊也設置選情作戰室，即時掌握開票進度。與川普關係密切的消息人士透露，川普仍期待民調失準、共和黨表現優於預期，但也曾私下坦承，已考慮共和黨可能面臨最糟糕的開票結果。兩名白宮官員則表示，幕僚團隊已做好因應各種情境的準備。

李其展示警：美股期指跳水　日韓股市同步轉弱

外匯專家李其展今早在臉書粉專《李其展的外匯交易致勝兵法》發文指出，美國部分地區開始開票後，美股期貨出現快速下跌，部分分析認為，共和黨參議院選情不佳可能是賣壓來源之一。亞洲市場也受到波及，原本開低的日經指數跌幅擴大至3.09％，韓國股市則從早盤上漲轉為翻黑；新台幣一早貶值破1角貶破32.86元，顯示外資可能仍在調節持股。李其展提醒，市場波動劇烈，投資人操作應更加謹慎。

台股反彈逾400點又翻黑

台股昨日重挫1,612.6點、失守4萬4000點，今日早盤一度反彈434點，最高來到43,741.54點，但隨後賣壓湧現，指數翻黑，盤中回落至42,955.57點，下跌351.97點，從高點回落逾785點。美股期貨同步走弱，道瓊期貨跌約0.34％、標普500期貨跌0.73％，那斯達克100期貨跌幅約1.53％。

此外，美伊軍事衝突升溫也加重市場不安，政策走向與地緣政治風險交織，使亞洲股市反彈力道受限。日經225指數盤中下跌逾3.09％，韓國KOSPI指數則由漲轉跌，記憶體族群漲勢也出現收斂。市場接下來將持續關注美國期中選舉開票結果，以及美伊局勢發展，短線資金動向與股市波動仍值得留意。

news.Title: 台積電最慘恐腰斬50％？分析師警告 台股大空頭要反轉了
news.Content:
台股昨（3日）暴跌1612點創下史上第七大跌點，指數破43300點支撐，上市櫃高達74檔跌停，融資多殺多賣壓湧出引發市場恐慌，分析師陳嘉偉認為，台股已有大空頭趨勢，且本周最恐怖的是台股企業即將陸續公布營收。

台股最慘狀況曝光 台積電恐腰斬？

看法向來偏空的陳嘉偉再次警告，台股不排除出現年線對稱跌幅，即代表從高點下殺至年線之後再跌一倍，回測至33678點，最糟狀況是回測五年線，即26882點附近，屆時台積電股價將腰斬，跌幅恐達46.2%。

陳嘉偉認為台股已進入大空頭走勢，跌破頸線就會出現M頭，關鍵點位落在4萬點，「先前就已經有假突破真大跌，台股初跌段，反彈都是進場放空的機會，適時回補，反而在大跌時不要追空，很容易被修理。」

台股下跌比預期更猛 下檔重要支撐移到41K

以國巨為例，陳嘉偉表示，國巨先前從高點下殺62.5%，現在出現好消息反而下跌，包括公布9月營收與10月底法說會，「國巨破底跌破年線，很有可能10月營收創下歷史次高，從高點開始衰退，這時候股價就會崩盤，連反彈都沒有。」

看法較為樂觀的專家仍未放棄年底5萬點的目標，法人提到，台股急跌主要是殺融資、AI現金流與新台幣貶值的風險，已經跌破黃金切割率0.618的43428點，因此下檔重要支撐就會往下降至黃金切割率0.809約41406點的位置。

後市觀察指標在於，美股與期中動態，台股融資餘額是否出現顯著減肥，包括台積電在內的指標個股能否止跌反彈，技術面12周RSI相對強弱指標應該盡速回到50以上，才有利中期局勢發展。

news.Title: 華邦電法說會行情失靈！盤中挫逾3％刷5個月最低 3萬多人「帳面1張蒸發9萬元」
news.Content:
記憶體大廠華邦電（2344）昨日舉行法說會，公布第3季稅後純益達354億元、年增逾12倍，單季EPS高達 7.58元，大賺超過半個股本，符合市場預期。但受「利多出盡」與第4季展望趨緩影響，今（4）日股價短暫上演慶祝行情後，由紅翻黑，最低觸及140.5％元，寫下5月28日以來、逾5個月盤中最低價，和 6月22日高點233.5元相比，短短5個月內下跌近4成，3萬多人追在高點，帳上一張已蒸發9.15萬元。分析師表示，短線主要受到PC消費需求放緩及明年記憶體漲幅收斂影響，使市場趨於觀望，不過，目前記憶體三雄本益比不到5倍、評價極度便宜，投資人可把握拉回時機逢低布局。

華邦電今天盤中向上衝高至148元即遭拋壓翻黑，最低下探140.5元，跌3.8％，股價寫下5個月盤中最低價。

回顧華邦電今年6月22日盤中最高233.5元，當周受益人數46萬3,762人，和前一周的42萬7,925人相比，增加3萬5837人，假設這3萬多人都追在高點，如今隨著華邦電失守200元關卡，又創5個月最低，帳上已蒸發9.15萬元。

針對華邦電「強勁財報難擋股價拉回」的現象，國泰證期顧問處協理郭經緯分析，主要受限於兩大隱憂：

第一，第4季營運動能趨緩

華邦電總經理陳沛銘於法說會中坦言，儘管AI需求旺盛，但受到PC等消費性電子需求放緩影響，第4季公司營運成長動能將相對平緩。

第二， 記憶體報價漲幅面臨收斂

陳沛銘雖指出明年記憶體市場依然供不應求，但調研機構與法人預估，包括NAND Flash與 DRAM（DDR）明年全年的價格漲幅，將從今年的倍數暴漲收斂至20%至30%左右。在報價漲幅趨緩下，短線股價難免受壓。

南亞科營收連 12 個月創新高也不漲

此外，DRAM 大廠南亞科（2408）昨日才公告 10 月合併營收達464.76億元，年增 487.73%），已連續12個月改寫單月歷史新高，且總經理李培瑛日前於法說會強調，第 4 季DRAM平均銷售單價（ASP）與毛利率將持續上漲，AI帶動的供需缺口非常大。但今日南亞科股價同樣不改頹勢，盤中最低觸及400.5元、重挫2.55%。

旺宏（2337）盤中雖一度大漲3.4%衝上91.3元，隨後也由紅翻黑下探87.6元，9字頭大關得而復失。

郭經緯指出，旺宏主攻利基型記憶體，南亞科則集中於DDR4與DDR5產品。儘管短線市場因報價漲幅收斂而進入觀望，但從估值角度來看，目前記憶體三雄的股價均處於歷史低檔，以明年預估獲利計算，本益比甚至不到 5 倍，「股價整體評價相當便宜」。

郭經緯進一步補充，雖然記憶體價格暴漲期過去，使族群股價短線轉為「區間操作」，但華邦電與南亞科題材後勁仍強，最大的潛在利多在於「高殖利率」。

由於兩家公司今年獲利均出現爆發性成長，若以過去的現金股利發放率推算，華邦電與南亞科明年的現金股息殖利率均有機會突破 10%。預計到了明年上半年，將展現強大的配息吸引力，進一步吸引高股息 ETF 與被動型資金進駐卡位。因此，在企業獲利持續向上、本益比偏低且有超高殖利率護體下，建議長線投資人無須過度悲觀，可把握股價拉回時機逢低分批布局。

陳依旻／財經特派記者副組長，主跑央行、證交所、投信投顧等

聯發科(2454)持續擴大與NVIDIA在AI運算領域的合作，除共同開發AI PC產品外，雙方也持續推進下一代系統單晶片(SoC)開發。聯發科指出，雙方合作的RTX Spark AI PC已於10月中旬上市，搭載聯發科與NVIDIA共同開發的N1X平台，鎖定Agentic AI應用及高效能運算需求，隨著首代產品正式進入市場，第二代SoC也持續開發中，進一步擴大聯發科在PC運算市場的布局。

news.Title: 台積電終結連4跌！漲25元站回2300元關卡 分析師：股價還是很便宜
news.Content:
受到台積電ADR止跌回升激勵，台積電（2330）今（4）日開高，盤中最高觸及2,320元、上漲 25 元，終結連四跌窘境，國泰證期顧問處協理郭經緯表示，目前台積電交易在明年預估獲利本益比不到 16 倍，中長線評價具吸引力，建議投資人可把握拉回時機逢低分批布局。

在美國期中選舉結果揭曉前夕，資金重新回流先前慘遭拋售的半導體與人工智慧（AI）族群，帶動美股週二（3日）走勢分化，費城半導體指數強勢勁揚2.63%，台積電ADR也同步上漲1.55%。

受美股提振，台積電（2330）今（4）日開盤展開反彈，盤中最高觸及2320元，較昨日收盤價2295元上漲25元、漲幅1.09%，終結連續四個交易日的下跌走勢，但隨後長是收斂，截至上午9:13，股價在2300元附近震盪，上漲5元。

針對台積電今日止跌回升的表現，國泰證期顧問處協理郭經緯分析指出，近期市場對AI投資出現兩大疑慮，導致先前科技股走勢偏弱，第一是關心「AI投資回收期」是否過長，第二則是憂心四大雲端服務供應商（CSP）的「自由現金流」受擠壓，恐進一步引發資本支出收斂的隱憂。儘管微軟第三季自由現金流表現強勁，但包含Google、Meta與亞馬遜（Amazon）在內的其他巨頭，自由現金流確實略顯吃緊，因而引發市場觀望。

不過，郭經緯強調，投資人無須過度悲觀，可從兩大正面關鍵來看待後市：

第一，四大雲端巨頭資本支出並未收斂

觀察四大CSP最新的明、後年資本支出規劃，整體投資力度並未放緩。今年四大巨頭資本支出合計預估超過7,000億美元，明年更有望逼近1兆美元大關。由於雲端大廠的資本支出直接轉化為台積電及台灣AI供應鏈的營收，顯示營運基本面依舊有撐。

第二，四大雲端營運現金流維持正向

雖然四大巨頭因擴大資本支出導致自由現金流面臨挑戰，但其「營運現金流」全數保持強勁的正數。這代表大廠並非財務吃緊，而是將賺來的現金高度轉投於AI基礎建設，展現對AI長期發展的信心。

郭經緯表示，雖然台積電近期股價失守2400元大關，今日於2300元附近震盪，但以中長期投資角度來看，目前台積電交易在明年預估獲利的本益比僅約15.8倍、不到16倍，評價面相當具吸引力。建議長線投資人不必過度受短線市場波動干擾，仍可把握拉回時機逢低分批布局。

陳依旻／財經特派記者副組長，主跑央行、證交所、投信投顧等

news.Title: 台股反彈305點！台積電漲20元、台光電噴5%

news.Title: 股災！台股暴跌逾1300點破42K 僅2大族群逆勢上漲
news.Content:
11:40更新：台股災情擴大，盤中下跌超過1300點跌破42000點重要支撐，台積電跌55元至2240元，台達電重挫7%至1180元，聯發科下殺逾5%，廣達與鴻海也跌逾3%。

11:06更新：台股賣壓沉重，盤中下殺逾千點不斷向下尋求支撐，觸及42216.36點，僅資服與電信類股相對抗跌，權值股與高價股成為重災區，台積電跌逾1%，台達電暴跌5%，聯發科也重摔逾4%。

10:45更新：台股盤中一路走低，盤中下跌逾800點觸及42451..92點，短短一個月已從49968.92點的歷史高點暴跌逾7500點，跌幅高達15%，台達電跌逾5%，聯發科、鴻海及廣達跌逾2%，權值股與高價股又遭提款，股王信驊重摔逾6%。

09:52更新：即使美股反彈，但亞洲市場追價意願不高，日韓股仍疲弱，台股盤中翻黑一度下跌超過350點摔破43000點，台積電下跌15元至2280元，台達電、鴻海與廣達跌逾1%，熱門族群PCB、CCL、記憶體及光通訊也都走低。

美股反彈，台股今（4日）也回穩，早盤以43449.45點開出，隨後上漲超過400點站回43700點，權值股台積電漲25元觸及2320元，聯發科漲70元觸及3745元，台達電漲30元觸及1300元，鴻海與廣達同步反彈。

外資持續提款，新台幣重貶1.68角破32.7元關卡，台股昨（3日）重挫1612.60點，收在43307.54點，成交值9280.58億元。三大法人合計賣超1464.56億元。自營商賣超590.55億元，投信買超199.05億元，外資及陸資賣超1073.06億元，創下史上第八大。

周二美股費城半導體指數反彈上漲2.63%，台積電ADR漲6.17美元或1.55%收在404.8美元，摩爾投顧分析師林漢偉指出，美股受到地緣政治風險降溫、國際油價持續下跌激勵，資金重新回流跌深電子股。雖然市場觀望美國期中選舉結果，交易相對清淡，但半導體股率先反彈，帶動美股多數收高。

台股有望受惠美股止跌，林漢偉認為，今日電子權值股有望帶動指數回升，但中小型股仍要留意融資多殺多的賣壓。今天重點觀察「反彈量能、外資籌碼、美國期中選舉」三大變數。

展望後市，工商報導，富邦投顧董事長陳奕光表示，這波台股急跌，主要是殺融資、殺AI現金流、殺新台幣貶值的風險，加權指數已跌破39,384點至49,968高點漲幅拉回0.618的43,428點，下檔支撐順勢下移至漲幅拉回0.809、約41,406點的位置。

news.Title: 《DJ在線》客戶搶簽長約，台記憶體三廠態度不同
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-11-04 09:02:17 周佩宇 發佈

記憶體客戶爭取供貨保障，長期供貨協議（LTA）也從採購安排，延伸成原廠擴產與投資的重要依據，不過南亞科（2408）、華邦電（2344）及旺宏（2337）的做法並不一致，但都強調，長約是否能連結客戶需求、設備投資與產品路線，比單純追求合約年限更重要。南亞科已有五至七成長約覆蓋，華邦正為新廠洽談搭配預付款的策略合作，旺宏目前則仍未簽訂LTA。

南亞科的長約已進入實際履約與續約階段。公司目前LTA覆蓋率約50%至70%，期間從一季至三年，客戶積極爭取延長供應期限。第三季售價大幅上升，也反映部分過去低價議定的舊約完成交貨後，開始適用新的合約價格，顯示長約雖能增加供需能見度，議價時點與續約安排仍會影響獲利反映速度。

後續擴建則以有客戶長約支持的AI專案為主要目標，林口5A廠預計明(2027)年第一季裝機，2028年底月投片目標3萬片、2030年底達5萬片；設備交期延長、安裝與驗證均需時間，現階段取得的長期需求，將分階段轉成未來供給。

華邦電則將長約與新廠設備投資直接連結。公司表示，希望選擇數家產品路線相符的策略夥伴，涵蓋2029年Module B新產能開出後至2032年的需求，目前有意洽談者已超過10家。合作模式包含客戶先支付訂金或預付款，支應設備投資，再由未來產品供應回饋，各家條件分別協商；例如車用客戶由LPDDR4轉向LPDDR5，若與華邦電未來路線一致，就更有建立長期合作的基礎。供給端則採分階段建置，這次核准731億元資本支出，涵蓋土建、機電及長交期設備，尚未包含全部設備支出，Module B月產6萬片也不會一次到位。這種安排將客戶未來用量、產品轉換與擴產節奏一起考量，也讓華邦電能提前處理設備採購及資金需求。

旺宏則保留不同選擇，董事長吳敏求提到，雖有許多客戶上門洽談，然仍未與任何一家簽訂LTA，因不把長約本身視為保障，更重視每份合約是否公平、互利，並持續優先服務長期合作客戶。而旺宏的擴產瓶頸仍在設備交期，他透露將拜訪設備商催交貨，而增加供給也不排除透過購併或與其他廠商合作。目前擴產規畫首階段新增產能會在2027年下半年量產，後續158億元投資的設備、預計2027年下半年至年底到位，量產落在2028年。

旺宏擴產評估購併、合作，接班人選已定

news.Title: 《DJ在線》AI排擠效應，台廠攻記憶體缺口策略分化
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-11-04 09:02:13 周佩宇 發佈

記憶體供給吃緊，台灣三家原廠的投資與產品取捨也逐漸拉開差異。從最新今(2026)年第三季法說會及會後採訪來看，南亞科（2408）維持跨世代DRAM供應，保留DDR4轉向DDR5的彈性；華邦電（2344）以DDR4、LPDDR4為近期主力，下一步低功耗產品瞄準LPDDR5；旺宏（2337）則將新增產能集中於NAND與eMMC，NOR則轉向高容量及高可靠度應用。三原廠共同面對大廠產品升級留下的供給缺口，但資源投入並未走向同一條路。

南亞科的策略是兼顧既有客戶與新世代產品。公司第三季DDR4與LPDDR4合計占產品營收逾六成，DDR5約一成；雖有能力依需求將DDR5比重提高至四成，惟目前DDR4客戶需求仍強，尚無大幅調整必要。公司也指出，DDR4、LPDDR4整體市場雖逐步縮小，剩餘需求相對仍大，依然具有經營空間，且應用從PC、車用及工業，延伸至伺服器、網通、儲存與系統管理。公司也同步拓展客製化AI記憶體，目前AI基礎設施相關營收已超過兩成，後續成長方向是增加高容量、高頻寬及客製化產品，但也不會棄守仍缺貨的成熟世代。

華邦電則更強調產品與客戶長期路線的契合。公司表示，現階段DDR4缺口已相當可觀，因此不必積極搶進標準型DDR5，後續低功耗產品規劃由LPDDR4走向LPDDR5，尤其重視車用等生命週期較長的需求。車用、工業客戶採用特定記憶體後，轉換不易，長期供貨能力因而成為爭取合作的重要條件；伺服器與基礎架構客戶也是新增需求來源。支撐這條路線的是20奈米DDR4、LPDDR4，以及已開始放量、預期明年顯著增加營收貢獻的16奈米製程。Flash方面，華邦持續提高高容量NOR與24奈米產品貢獻，AI需求除伺服器運算，也涵蓋交換器及SmartNIC等網通設備。

旺宏相對加重NAND的重要性，尤其是eMMC。公司第三季NAND相關業務含eMMC占營收47%，略高於NOR的46%，其中eMMC營收季增27%。董事長吳敏求說明，大廠淡出部分低容量NAND帶來承接機會，然既有產能卻有限，因此新增產能將投入NAND、eMMC，部分原供NOR使用的產能也轉往NAND；明年eMMC以96層3D NAND為主力，藉製程集中與較佳獲利能力提高資源效率。市場選擇上，目前NAND含eMMC仍以通訊應用為大宗，第三季占比52%，工業、車用等長期需求亦持續布局；NOR則保留資料中心、太空通訊、醫療及車用等市場，高容量產品仍持續開發。

由此可見，三家產品分化的重點，在於選擇哪些缺口值得持續投資、哪些客戶值得保留產能；南亞科與華邦在DDR4、LPDDR4仍有重疊，華邦與旺宏也同樣經營NOR，但各自優先投入的製程、產品與新增產能已有差異。

news.Title: 智原推強化版乙太網路PHY IP，攻AI智慧製造等應用
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-11-04 09:01:31 新聞中心 發佈

智原(3035)昨(3)日發表支援EtherCAT的強化版10/100乙太網路PHY IP解決方案於聯電(2303)製程，滿足AI智慧製造、工業自動化與人形機器人對即時通訊及同步運動控制日益增長的需求。公司指出，此預先驗證IP支援少於100微秒的EtherCAT傳輸時間，並透過EtherCAT分散式時鐘(Distributed Clocks, DC)實現少於0.1微秒的同步精度，同時通過嚴謹的ETG.7000合規性及IEC 61000-4測試，協助客戶簡化ASIC開發並提升產品開發效率。

此智原Ethernet PHY IP採用DSP架構，結合穩健的類比電路設計，提供優異的抗雜訊能力，並能在嚴峻的電氣干擾環境下維持穩定運作。該PHY IP已依據ETG.7000合規性測試規範通過EtherCAT裝置相容性及網路互通性測試，以及涵蓋靜電放電(ESD)、輻射射頻(RF)、電氣快速瞬變/脈衝群(EFT/Burst) 、突波(Surge)及傳導射頻(Conducted RF)等干擾的關鍵IEC 61000-4電磁相容性(EMC)測試。其可靠度亦透過長達一小時以上的電快速瞬變脈衝群抗擾度測試進一步驗證，在電磁閥產生高頻EFT/Burst脈衝的條件下，確認硬體保護機制及通訊完整性。透過IP層級的強化設計完成預先驗證，可協助客戶減少系統層級的設計與驗證工作，並降低開發風險。

智原營運長林世欽表示：「即時連線能力與優異的抗雜訊穩健性，對次世代工業系統至關重要，尤其在AI日益融入製造與實體機器的趨勢下更是如此。智原將EtherCAT相容性與EMC驗證整合於IP層級，協助客戶簡化系統開發，並降低高額的重新驗證風險。未來智原將持續擴展乙太網路IP產品布局，支援工業AI、軟體定義汽車及人形機器人等應用，包括10/100/1000BASE-T1及單對乙太網路(Single Pair Ethernet, SPE)解決方案。」

news.Content:
【昨日盤勢】：

儘管美伊重啟談判導致油價大跌，惟市場對於AI龐大的融資及資本支出能否帶來獲利仍存疑慮，費半指數持續遭遇賣壓重挫，也連帶拖累周二亞股。台股週二出現開低，儘管早盤台積電有特地買盤撐盤，然10點半後賣壓再度湧現，終場加權指數呈現長黑重挫。盤面下跌家數高達1784家，其中74家收盤跌停，資訊軟體受惠AI資安需求，成為資金避風港。權值股方面，台積電下跌1.50%、鴻海下跌2.19%、聯發科下跌7.43%、廣達下跌2.04%，台達電下跌6.27%。盤面強勢股，力新、大世科、仁大資訊、全景軟體、藍新資訊、強新、泰合等共13檔漲停；台玻、上亞科技、德淵、佳大、彬台、美德醫療-DR等漲幅3%以上。盤面弱勢股，華邦電、南亞科、南亞、華新科、穩懋、景碩、南電、金居、台燿等74檔個股跌停；聯鈞、玉晶光、欣興、良維、波若威、合晶等跌幅9%以上。終場台灣加權指數下跌1612.60點，以43307.54點作收，成交量9280.59億元。觀察盤面變化，三大類股同步下跌，電子下跌3.69%、傳產下跌3.75%、金融下跌2.54%。在次族群部份，以玻璃陶瓷、食品表現較佳，分別上漲5.36%、0.02%。

【資金動向】：

三大法人合計賣超1479.01億元。其中外資賣超1073.07億元，投信買超184.6億元，自營商賣超590.54億元。外資買超前五大為台玻、華航、長榮航、中鋼、寶成；賣超前五大為華邦電、力積電、南亞、凱基金、群創。投信買超前五大為台玻、中信金、台新新光金、國泰金、玉山金；賣超前五大為聯電、國巨*、華星光、南亞科、台塑化。資券變化方面，融資減229.25億元，融資餘額為5997.74億元，融券增6.3萬張，融券餘額為25.8萬張。外資台指期部位，空單增加2382口，淨空單部位91812口，借券賣出金額619.72億元。類股成交比重：電子83.09%、傳產13.20%、金融3.71%。

【今日盤勢分析】：

美國期中選舉週二登場，投資人等待選舉結果，儘管蘋果財測引發獲利疑慮，股價下跌近 2%，然資金回流近期遭到拋售的半導體族群，美股週二四大指數漲跌互見，台積電ADR上漲1.55%，台指期夜盤上漲426點。盤後AMD及SMCI公布財報，營收與獲利均雙雙優於市場預期，兩檔個股盤後均上漲逾7%。台股後市分析如下：

第一、中經院公布10月經季節調整後的製造業採購經理人指數（PMI）為62.5，相較9月，指數回跌0.9。中經院表示，PMI已連13月呈現擴張，即指數站穩50榮枯值以上，但擴張速度有趨緩之勢。

第二、台灣資本市場迎來大爆發，台股市值一舉超越英國與印度，強勢擠進全球第4大市場。那斯達克（Nasdaq）執行副董事長Edward Knight在台灣週活動演講時指出，台積電市值衝破2兆美元，躍升為全球第7大、也是全美之外最大企業，同時最新研調顯示台灣AI曝險部位高達71％居全亞太之冠，展現台灣在全球AI浪潮與資本市場不可替代的樞紐地位。

第三、技術面觀察，週二加權指數出現量增長黑K；技術指標，KD、RSI低檔鈍化，MACD維持綠柱體擴大。整體技術面弱勢整理，且進入超跌區，現階段進入融資多殺多，靜待止跌K線出現，後續觀察融資減幅及外資期現貨態度，視為醞釀跌深反彈指標。OTC指數跌破年線，短線仍需留意融資多殺多及法人籌碼鬆動。

第四、盤面資金聚焦資訊服務、部分玻纖布等個股，包括力新、大世科、全景軟體及台玻等表現強勢。

【投資策略】：

台股急跌後，短期技術面呈現負乖離擴大，且進入超賣區，搭配美股AMD及SMCI財報利多，及過往美國期中選舉選後上漲機率高，短期有望醞釀反彈。惟在對AI前景擔憂的情緒下，外資持續對台股進行提款，內資則維持基本面樂觀的心態，使本波大盤累計回檔達13.56%，融資減幅卻僅8.19%，浮額清洗尚不完全。操作建議，籌碼清洗不足，建議保持資金彈性，降低槓桿，短期聚焦10月營收與4Q26法說展望優異的業績題材股，長線追蹤族群：台積電及先進封測、PCB供應鏈、光傳輸、散熱、貨櫃散裝、特用化學及金融股等。

news.Title: 別殺低！專家揭台股「2大藏寶細節」：只是多頭大洗牌
news.Content:
台股11/3（二）遭逢重挫，分析師周代運表示，投資人切勿被恐慌情緒綁架。觀察盤面可發現台積電僅微跌1.5%展現強勁抗跌力，以及聯發科雖逢股價修正卻獲外資調升目標價等兩大細節，顯示此波殺盤僅為高檔籌碼清洗與浮額調節，長線基本面並未翻空，實屬多頭行情中的大修正。

權重龍頭展現抗跌力

分析師周代運指出，大跌當天不能只看指數表現，更應關注權重龍頭股的抵抗力道。昨日大盤重挫期間，諸多電子股、載板與記憶體族群面臨重摔，不少個股大跌6～7%甚至跌停。然而，作為台股定海神針的台積電全天僅下跌1.5%。若本次下跌屬於基本面翻空或崩盤級賣壓，台積電定會首當其衝領跌。今日走勢證明此波賣壓並非外資看壞台灣半導體核心基本面，而是高檔獲利盤集中出場的籌碼調整，龍頭股並未崩盤，大盤便不易出現無底洞式的連續重殺。

聯發科獲外資調高目標價

針對聯發科今日的重挫，周代運強調必須釐清「股價短期回檔」與「法人長線看法」的差異。外資在此波回檔過程中出具報告，維持買進評等並同步調高目標價。外資看好聯發科的核心邏輯，在於其已跨越單純手機晶片廠範疇，透過與輝達戰略合作，加上車用晶片、邊緣AI及資料中心ASIC等新業務逐步放量，正開啟第二與第三成長曲線。短期股價大跌僅為情緒面殺壓與籌碼調節，法人看重的是未來2～3年的營運展望，證明長線基本面並未轉壞。

高檔洗籌碼宜分批逢低布局

綜合台積電抗跌守底與聯發科獲外資上修目標價等兩大訊號，周代運認為兩大指標股皆未出現基本面翻空跡象，今日長黑K線屬於多頭行情中的大修正與浮額清洗，而非行情終點。在操作策略上，建議投資人切勿恐慌殺低，亦不必急於一次性all in搶反彈；優質標的待拉回後可分批逢低布局，控管好倉位並保留現金以應對後續震盪。市場在大跌時賣的是恐懼，而長線獲利賺取的是企業基本面的成長。

news.Title: 智原適用於聯電、支援EtherCAT強化版10/100乙太網路PHY IP方案問世
news.Content:
【財訊快報／記者李純君報導】ASIC設計服務業者智原科技(3035)，宣布發表適用於聯電(2303)、支援EtherCAT的強化版10/100乙太網路PHY IP解決方案，主攻AI智慧製造、工業自動化與人形機器人對即時通訊及同步運動控制日益增長的市場商機。智原提到，此預先驗證IP支援少於100微秒的EtherCAT傳輸時間，並透過EtherCAT分散式時鐘(Distributed Clocks, DC)實現少於0.1微秒的同步精度，同時通過嚴謹的ETG.7000合規性(Conformance)及IEC 61000-4測試，協助客戶簡化ASIC開發並提升產品開發效率。

再者，此Ethernet PHY IP採用DSP架構，結合類比電路設計，提供抗雜訊能力，並能在嚴峻的電氣干擾環境下維持穩定運作。該PHY IP已依據ETG.7000合規性測試規範通過EtherCAT裝置相容性及網路互通性測試，以及涵蓋靜電放電(ESD)、輻射射頻(RF)、電氣快速瞬變／脈衝群(EFT/Burst)、突波(Surge)及傳導射頻(Conducted RF)等干擾的關鍵IEC 61000-4電磁相容性(EMC)測試。其可靠度亦透過長達一小時以上的電快速瞬變脈衝群抗擾度測試進一步驗證，在電磁閥產生高頻EFT/Burst脈衝的條件下，確認硬體保護機制及通訊完整性。透過IP層級的強化設計完成預先驗證，可協助客戶減少系統層級的設計與驗證工作，並降低開發風險。

智原營運長林世欽表示：「即時連線能力與優異的抗雜訊穩健性，對次世代工業系統至關重要，尤其在AI日益融入製造與實體機器的趨勢下更是如此。智原將EtherCAT相容性與EMC驗證整合於IP層級，協助客戶簡化系統開發，並降低高額的重新驗證風險。未來智原將持續擴展乙太網路IP產品布局，支援工業AI、軟體定義汽車及人形機器人等應用，包括10/100/1000BASE-T1及單對乙太網路 (Single Pair Ethernet, SPE) 解決方案。」

news.Title: 費半止跌反彈＋超微財報報喜助攻，KOSPI早盤急彈3%，DRAM雙雄領漲
news.Content:
【財訊快報／陳孟朔】韓國股市週三(4日)早盤強勁反彈，韓國綜合股價指數(KOSPI)漲幅擴大至3%，DRAM雙雄三星電子與SK海力士同步走揚，成為帶動大盤回升的主力。隔夜美國半導體股止跌，加上超微(AMD)財報與營收展望優於預期，提振近期承受賣壓的韓國科技股買氣。依最新取得的盤中快訊，SK海力士(000660.KS)上漲約4.8%，三星電子(005930.KS)上漲約3.6%。兩檔權值股同步反彈，帶動韓股收復前一交易日部分失地。

美國晶片股回穩提供支撐，連續三個交易日急瀉1,355.67點或11.6%的費城半導體指數，週二反彈272.07點或2.63%，收在10,600.40點。超微盤後公布第三季營收年增45%，數據中心收入接近倍增，第四季營收預估約170億美元、高於市場預期，為AI晶片需求前景增添正面訊號。

韓股週二重挫210.29點或3.59%，收5,648.79點，三星電子與SK海力士均為主要拖累來源，週三則隨美國晶片族群回升。不過，美國期中選舉結果仍待揭曉，市場對AI資本支出及投資回報的疑慮也未完全消退，雙雄能否守住漲幅、帶動大盤延續反彈，仍是當日盤面觀察重點。

news.Title: Stock Market Today, Nov. 3: Marvell Shares Edge Higher After Premarket Drop on $115 Billion Lumentum Deal
news.Content:
Marvell Technology (NASDAQ:MRVL), a data infrastructure semiconductor provider, closed at $171.97, up 0.33%. Shares were volatile after a premarket sell-off tied to the company's $115-billion acquisition of Lumentum and several analyst downgrades.

Trading volume reached 37.6 million shares, coming in about 67% above its three-month average of 22.6 million shares. Marvell Technology IPO'd in 2000 and has grown 1,114% since going public.

How the markets moved today

The S&P 500 (SNPINDEX:^GSPC) rose 0.36% to 7,569, and the Nasdaq Composite (NASDAQINDEX:^IXIC) gained 0.83% to 25,372. Among semiconductor equipment and integrated circuits for data center and networking infrastructure peers, Broadcom closed at $332.13, up 3.07%, while Arista Networks finished at $169.91, up 3.52%, as AI-infrastructure spending remained in focus.

What this means for investors

On Tuesday, Nov. 3, Marvell shares gained the day after plunging about 13% on its announcement of a $115 billion all-stock acquisition of Lumentum, a provider of optical components critical to efficient data transmission, a desirable feature for artificial intelligence systems. The risk of share dilution from the deal combined with Toronto-Dominion Bank 's TD Cowen issuing a Hold downgrade, contributed to Marvell's stock decline.

The fact that Marvell shares experienced an uptick today signals that Wall Street may have considered the stock oversold. After all, Marvell's move to own Lumentum is poised to turbocharge revenue growth.

Before the deal, Marvell had already raised its revenue outlook for its 2028 fiscal year (FY), ended Jan. 31, 2028, to $20 billion, and set a FY2031 target of $70 billion to $90 billion in sales. This represents massive growth from its FY2026 revenue of $8.2 billion.

Lumentum adds another fast-growing business to Marvell's offerings. Lumentum announced fiscal Q1 earnings on Nov. 2, reporting a spectacular 137% year-over-year increase in sales to $1.3 billion. It's no wonder Wall Street is reassessing the acquisition today.

news.Title: Apollo Global Management Q3 Earnings Call Highlights
news.Content:
Key Points

Interested in Apollo Global Management Inc.? Here are five stocks we like better.

Apollo reported record third-quarter fee-related earnings of $802 million, up 23% year over year, and said it remains on track for more than 20% fee-related earnings growth and 10% spread-related earnings growth in 2026.

The firm originated a record $114 billion, with more than 80% of its debt originations rated investment grade. Amid tight spreads and elevated valuations, Apollo said it is favoring higher-quality, secured credit and lower-leverage equity investments.

Fundraising and retirement-services inflows remained strong: asset-management inflows reached $35 billion, while Athene recorded $61 billion of inflows year to date. Apollo also plans to invest about $350 million over two years in technology and systems for private markets.

Broadcom's Anthropic Bet Gets Bigger as $60 Billion Financing Raises the Stakes

Apollo Global Management (NYSE:APO) reported record third-quarter fee-related earnings and said it remains on track to meet its 2026 growth targets, supported by strong origination, fundraising and retirement-services inflows.

The alternative asset manager generated fee-related earnings of $802 million, or $1.28 per share, up 23% from a year earlier and 2% from the prior quarter. Spread-related earnings, excluding notable items, totaled $909 million, or $1.46 per share. Adjusted net income was $1.3 billion, or $2.07 per share, and $2.15 per share excluding notable items.

→ L3Harris Stock Took a Beating—Is a 20% Rebound Next?

Broadcom's AI Growth Story Faces a $161 Billion Anthropic Test

Chief Executive Officer Marc Rowan said Apollo originated a record $114 billion during the quarter, with capital formation totaling $53 billion, including $35 billion in asset management and $19 billion at Athene. He said the firm's average origination spread was 330 basis points over Treasuries with an average BBB rating.

"Capital formation follows attractive origination," Rowan said, adding that Apollo was on track for more than 20% fee-related earnings growth and 10% spread-related earnings growth in 2026.

Origination Focus Shifts Toward Higher-Quality Credit

→ LyondellBasell's Dividend Looks Safer, But a New Risk Could Change That

Baggage Claim: Apollo's $7.7 Billion Bid to Acquire easyJet

Apollo executives described a cautious investment posture amid elevated valuations, tight spreads and rising risks. Rowan said the firm is reducing credit risk by favoring investment-grade and secured lending over below-investment-grade and unsecured exposures. In equity investing, Apollo is seeking lower leverage, hybrid structures and businesses it views as durable through technology cycles.

Story Continues

President Jim Zelter said $98 billion of the quarter's $114 billion in originations was debt, with more than 80% of that debt classified as investment grade and carrying an average BBB+ rating. Total origination over the past 12 months reached $356 billion.

→ Marvell Eyes a Swing for the AI Networking Fences as Markets Weigh Lumentum Price Tag

On investment-grade originations, Apollo generated spreads of 285 basis points over Treasuries, or about 200 basis points over comparable corporate indexes, Zelter said. Sub-investment-grade originations generated spreads of 430 basis points over Treasuries, or about 160 basis points over comparable corporates.

The firm highlighted financings across energy, infrastructure, sports and computing, including a $40 billion GPU financing for SpaceX. Zelter said Apollo's approach to artificial intelligence-related financing has centered on power and chips, where management sees capital imbalances and attractive risk-adjusted returns.

"Never take equity-like risk for debt-like returns," Zelter said.

Asset Management Earnings and Fundraising

Management fees rose 18% year over year, supported by third-party fundraising across credit and equity strategies, capital deployment and growth at Athene and Athora. Assets under management rose 18% from a year earlier, while fee-generating assets under management increased 28%.

Capital solutions fees reached a record $290 million, marking the sixth consecutive quarter above $200 million. Chief Financial Officer Martin Kelly said the fees came from more than 115 discrete transactions, split roughly 60% from credit and 40% from equity.

Kelly said Apollo has increasingly structured financings that produce and recognize fees over multiple quarters or years rather than upfront. He noted that the Broadcom financing did not contribute to third-quarter capital solutions fees because of the timing of capital draws and the fee structure.

Fee-related expenses increased about 15% from a year earlier as Apollo invested in long-term growth initiatives. Still, its fee-related earnings margin expanded about 150 basis points year over year to 58%.

For 2027, Apollo expects more than 20% fee-related earnings growth, supported by more than 15% management-fee growth and continued expansion in origination-led capital solutions fees. The outlook incorporates lower fees from MFIC and ARI and an estimated low-single-digit contribution from the combination of Fund XI and Fund X.

Asset-management inflows totaled $35 billion in the quarter, with about two-thirds directed to credit and one-third to equity. Apollo's AMAPS program reached $30 billion following its sixth issuance, while the related AMAPS and APADS offerings together reached about $40 billion in roughly one year, according to management.

Athene Inflows Remain Strong Despite Actuarial Item

Athene's net invested assets increased 13% year over year to $322 billion. The retirement-services unit reported $909 million of spread-related earnings excluding notable items.

Reported spread-related earnings included a $65 million unfavorable impact from Athene's annual third-quarter actuarial assumption review. Kelly said the adjustment was principally driven by revisions to estimated usage of income-rider features by annuitants.

Athene's reported net spread excluding notable items was 114 basis points, unchanged from the prior quarter. On an adjusted basis using Apollo's 11% long-term alternatives-return assumption, net spread would have been 121 basis points, within management's previously stated full-year outlook of 120 to 125 basis points.

Athene recorded $61 billion of inflows year to date. During the quarter, retail contributed $10 billion, funding agreements added $6 billion and flow reinsurance added $2 billion. Rowan said the company expects future retirement-services growth to increasingly involve product innovation and broader access to guaranteed-income solutions.

Kelly said late-quarter deployment of assets from cash into yielding investments should support approximately $1 billion of fourth-quarter spread-related earnings on the same basis, implying expected 2026 growth of about 10%. Apollo also expects 10% spread-related earnings growth in 2027, assuming an 11% return on alternatives.

Investment in Private-Markets Infrastructure

Rowan outlined plans to invest roughly $350 million over the next 24 months in technology, data and systems intended to make private assets easier to price, identify, trade, custody and settle. Apollo plans to write off older software and replace existing systems, with much of the effort based in Austin, Texas.

The company has already moved its investment-grade suite and broader credit business to estimated daily values. Rowan said Apollo expects to begin pursuing custody and settlement capabilities for credit assets in 2027 through partnerships.

Management believes the infrastructure could create additional revenue opportunities beyond traditional management and performance fees, including market making, financing and other services around private assets. Rowan said Apollo expects to maintain margins while making the investments, citing opportunities to increase capacity through technology.

"This is about revenue at this point," Rowan said in response to a question about the investment program.

Separately, Apollo announced after the quarter that it agreed to make a minority equity investment in Mubadala Capital, the asset-management arm of Mubadala Investment Company. The transaction, which is expected to close late in the fourth quarter subject to customary approvals, will be funded with a combination of cash and debt. Apollo also noted that Ares Capital Corp. agreed to acquire its publicly traded BDC, MidCap Financial Investment Corp., in a stock-and-cash transaction.

About Apollo Global Management (NYSE:APO)

Apollo Global Management, Inc (NYSE:APO) is a global alternative asset manager that provides investment solutions to institutions, companies and individual investors. The firm manages strategies across private equity, credit, real assets, infrastructure, secondaries and other alternative investments.

Apollo invests across a range of industries and geographies, supporting companies through buyouts, growth investments, structured financing and other forms of private capital. Its credit business provides lending and fixed-income solutions, while its real assets and infrastructure strategies focus on areas such as energy, transportation, communications and other essential services.

The company was founded in 1990 by Leon Black, Josh Harris and Marc Rowan.

news.Title: Elon Musk’s Tesla and SpaceX protest NYSE parent's new plan
news.Content:
Elon Musk 's SpaceX (Nasdaq: SPCX) and Tesla (Nasdaq: TSLA), along with Amazon (Nasdaq: AMZN), Netflix (Nasdaq: NTFX), Lam Research (Nasdaq: LRCX), and SoFi Technologies (Nasdaq: SOFI), have finally objected to the tokenization of their stocks on the OKXICE TSV .

OKXICE TSV is a proposed tokenized stock trading platform created by OKXICE, a 50-50 joint venture between the New York Stock Exchange parent company Intercontinental Exchange (NYSE: ICE) and the OKX crypto exchange.

What's behind the objection

Tokenization is the process of using blockchain technology to turn real‑world assets (RWAs) such as stocks, real estate, government bonds, etc. into digital tokens, which can be traded fractionally, 24/7.

While the stock tokens offer traders from outside the U.S. indirect exposure to the American stock market, they don't offer shareholder rights such as ownership, voting, etc., like original stocks do.

It's the Securities and Exchange Commission's (SEC) innovation exemption issued in September that allows exchanges like OKXICE to offer tokenized U.S. stocks without registering as exchanges.

But the exemption also allows companies to object to their stocks being tokenized by third parties like OKXICE.

The platform's initial notice got published on Oct. 4, and the SEC's rule lets notified companies object to the plan within 30 days. So, companies have until Nov. 3 to object to it.

This is exactly what companies like Tesla and SpaceX did today: exercise their power to protest the tokenized stock plan.

TheStreet Roundtable spoke to Markus Levin, co-founder of XYO, a cryptographic proof network for data and AI, to get insights on the subject.

"I read this as companies objecting to someone else tokenizing their stock rather than to tokenization itself, since a third-party token leaves the issuer with little visibility into who holds its shares or how votes and dividends reach them. "said Levin. I'd expect most of them to tokenize their own stock through their transfer agents once there's a clear standard for keeping the token and the shareholder register in sync," he added.

news.Title: Skyworks Solutions (SWKS) Tops Q4 Earnings and Revenue Estimates
news.Content:
Skyworks Solutions (SWKS) came out with quarterly earnings of $1.28 per share, beating the Zacks Consensus Estimate of $1.27 per share. This compares to earnings of $1.76 per share a year ago. These figures are adjusted for non-recurring items.

This quarterly report represents an earnings surprise of +0.79%. A quarter ago, it was expected that this chipmaker would post earnings of $1.03 per share when it actually produced earnings of $1.08, delivering a surprise of +4.85%.

Over the last four quarters, the company has surpassed consensus EPS estimates four times.

Skyworks, which belongs to the Zacks Semiconductors - Radio Frequency industry, posted revenues of $1.05 billion for the quarter ended September 2026, surpassing the Zacks Consensus Estimate by 1.49%. This compares to year-ago revenues of $1.1 billion. The company has topped consensus revenue estimates four times over the last four quarters.

The sustainability of the stock's immediate price movement based on the recently-released numbers and future earnings expectations will mostly depend on management's commentary on the earnings call.

Skyworks shares have added about 34.3% since the beginning of the year versus the S&P 500's gain of 10.2%.

What's Next for Skyworks?

While Skyworks has outperformed the market so far this year, the question that comes to investors' minds is: what's next for the stock?

There are no easy answers to this key question, but one reliable measure that can help investors address this is the company's earnings outlook. Not only does this include current consensus earnings expectations for the coming quarter(s), but also how these expectations have changed lately.

Empirical research shows a strong correlation between near-term stock movements and trends in earnings estimate revisions. Investors can track such revisions by themselves or rely on a tried-and-tested rating tool like the Zacks Rank, which has an impressive track record of harnessing the power of earnings estimate revisions.

Ahead of this earnings release, the estimate revisions trend for Skyworks was mixed. While the magnitude and direction of estimate revisions could change following the company's just-released earnings report, the current status translates into a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) for the stock. So, the shares are expected to perform in line with the market in the near future. You can see the complete list of today's Zacks #1 Rank (Strong Buy) stocks here.

It will be interesting to see how estimates for the coming quarters and the current fiscal year change in the days ahead. The current consensus EPS estimate is $1.30 on $1.05 billion in revenues for the coming quarter and $5.18 on $4.06 billion in revenues for the current fiscal year.

Story Continues

Investors should be mindful of the fact that the outlook for the industry can have a material impact on the performance of the stock as well. In terms of the Zacks Industry Rank, Semiconductors - Radio Frequency is currently in the bottom 12% of the 250 plus Zacks industries. Our research shows that the top 50% of the Zacks-ranked industries outperform the bottom 50% by a factor of more than 2 to 1.

Another stock from the broader Zacks Computer and Technology sector, nLight (LASR), has yet to report results for the quarter ended September 2026. The results are expected to be released on November 5.

This laser maker is expected to post quarterly earnings of $0.06 per share in its upcoming report, which represents a year-over-year change of -25%. The consensus EPS estimate for the quarter has remained unchanged over the last 30 days.

nLight's revenues are expected to be $67.96 million, up 1.8% from the year-ago quarter.

news.Title: Q4 QQQ Roadmap: Navigating AI Turbulence & Market Headwinds
news.Content:
2026 Stock Market Review

Here is a roadmap of what has occurred with the Nasdaq 100 Index ( QQQ ) in 2026.

Image Source: TradingView

Overall, there are 3 major takeaways:

1) The market continues to climb the proverbial wall of worry. If I had told you oil and rates are where they are, and the market has held up this well, few would have believed me.

2) The market and the economy depend heavily AI. The slightest concern of AI infrastructure spending slowing sends stocks crashing.

3) Market indices don't tell the full story.

Tech Destruction

Last year, investors complained that tech was holding up the market; now the narrative has flipped. QQQ just suffered its worst 3-day decline since "Liberation Day." Meanwhile, according to Morgan Stanley, U.S. tech momentum, or the lack of it, has been worse than the dot-com bust.

Image Source: Morgan Stanley

What is Holding Back the Equity Market?

· Inflation/Higher Interest Rates

· AI Political Headwinds

· AI Funding/Debt Fears

· Gravity/Profit Taking

Below I explain why the market will overcome these hurdles in the coming months:

Inflation & Higher Rates

Higher energy prices have led to inflation concerns and higher interest rates. That said, geopolitical energy shocks are often short-lived. Tuesday, energy prices fell sharply after Al-Araby Al-Jadeed reported progress toward a US–Iran agreement involving nuclear concessions and frozen funds.

The latest projections lean heavily toward 3 to 4 rate hikes (25 bps increments) over the path extending into mid-to-late 2027. According to BlueKurtic Market Insights (@BlueKurtic), the data shows that equities can perform well during rate-hiking cycles, especially if the pace is measured. This looks like a non-cyclical hike, with no more than 2-3 hikes. This scenario usually hasn't been bad for stocks. The last non-cyclical hike was in 1997, and the S&P 500 gained 40% over the next year, outperforming longer hiking cycles.

Image Source: BlueKurtic Market Insights

Midterm Election Impact: Gridlock is Good

According to a Reuters Poll, only a third of Americans approve of the fast pace of data-center construction. In my view, the stock market has been pricing in a Democratic "Blue Wave" for a few months now, and that is part of why we have seen carnage in AI stocks. Nevertheless, the stock market during periods of divided government has "typically exceeded returns achieved when one political party controls the White House, Senate, and House of Representatives."

The stock market has been pricing in a "Blue Wave" for a few months now, and that is part of the reasons we have seen carnage in AI stocks. In other words, because the market is a forward discounting mechanism, I believe it will result in a classic "sell the rumor, buy the news" situation. Seasonality data backs this notion up. The S&P 500 has finished higher in the six months following every midterm election since 1950. That's 19 consecutive elections with an average gain of nearly 15% regardless of which party came out on top.

Story Continues

Image Source: Liquid.Trade (@liquidperps)

AI Debt/Funding Fears

CoreWeave ( CRWV ) shares plunged in October after its bond yields jumped to distressed levels. Although CoreWeave is plagued by high-debt levels, the market has been acting as if it will go bankrupt. However, betting markets suggest that won't happen any time soon. In September, PolyMarket priced a 2027 CoreWeave bankruptcy as high as 50%. Today, that number is just 12%.

Image Source: PolyMarket

Tech Stock Gravity & Profit Taking

Earlier this year, many AI-related names went too far, too fast. For example, SanDisk ( SNDK ) blew past the 4.236% bull flag Fibonacci extension by a lot (highly unusual and very rare) and jumped 4,000% in a year. Also, shares were 264% above the 200-day. Typically, a stock 200% above the 200-day is very extreme. In other words, AI stocks got too far ahead of themselves. I think of the 200-day MA as a bungee cord. If it gets too far, it pulls you back in. However, even the strongest stocks retreat to the 200-day. Now, I believe it has overshot. The first touch is often a fantastic area. We are seeing this across many AI stocks including, Marvell ( MRVL ), Arm Holdings ( ARM ), Micron ( MU ), and many others.

Bottom Line

While headline fears around AI leverage, interest rates, and political shifts have triggered sharp sector rotation, the market's technical foundation remains intact. Extended growth leaders are completing necessary mean-reversion pullbacks to major moving averages, clearing out leverage while forward-looking indicators point to a classic post-midterm rally. As historical seasonality and political gridlock align with favorable risk-reward entries across core infrastructure names, the current pullback presents a compelling backdrop for the next leg higher.

news.Title: While the Rest of the Market Focuses on the Anthropic IPO, These Are My Top 2 Stocks to Buy in November
news.Content:
The biggest stock market news in November will likely be the initial public offering of Anthropic, which is likely to happen sometime before Thanksgiving. There will be a lot of fanfare and enthusiasm surrounding Anthropic stock when it goes public , but I expect it will eventually fade, much like what happened after Space Exploration Technologies ' IPO earlier this year.

However, two companies that have strong business relationships with Anthropic look like fantastic investments now: Nvidia (NASDAQ: NVDA) and Broadcom (NASDAQ: AVGO). Both stocks look highly attractive, and I think investors should pick up shares of them in November rather than waiting for Anthropic to debut.

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

Anthropic is a major customer of Nvidia and Broadcom

Nvidia and Broadcom both make AI computing units. Nvidia makes graphics processing units (GPUs) , while Broadcom makes custom AI chips. The companies are competing for shares of the same market in data centers, but there is plenty of room for both to succeed, and each chipmaker tackles a different problem.

Nvidia's GPUs are the industry standard in AI computing. They work well in nearly every application where heavy parallel processing power is the key requirement, making them highly flexible and repurposable for an array of computationally intense tasks. However, because they're not optimized for any one task, they're less cost-efficient when placed in servers where they'll be handling just one type of workload for their entire lifespan.

That's where a custom AI computing unit from Broadcom makes a lot of sense. Instead of offering a flexible, one-size-fits-all chip, it partners directly with hyperscalers to design AI chips that are tailored to their specific workloads. While Anthropic isn't designing its own chips right now, it is using chips co-designed by Alphabet (Google's parent company) and Broadcom. Those Tensor Processing Units (TPUs) can outperform GPUs from a cost perspective on some types of AI workloads, which makes them an attractive choice for Anthropic.

Sometimes, it's better to own the supplier's stock rather than the customer's, and I think that's the case here. Broadcom and Nvidia already have an established business with huge profit margins and high growth. With Anthropic, it's more important to remember that not every promising, fast-growing company manages to make the pivot to long-term profitability.

Story Continues

Fortunately, both Broadcom and Nvidia are priced pretty attractively right now, making them excellent buys.

Nvidia and Broadcom have no 2027 growth priced into their stocks

Nvidia and Broadcom may be the poster children of the AI processor segment, but the market has shown no respect for their 2027 growth prospects. If we utilize next year's earnings projections to value these stocks, they trade at massive discounts to their current trailing price-to-earnings ratios.

NVDA PE Ratio data by YCharts.

The question is, what is a fair P/E ratio to pay for these two? I think something like 30 times trailing earnings is a fair price to pay. So, if Nvidia hits its earnings projections for next year, the stock could rise by over 100%. For Broadcom to trade at that level a year from now, it would have to almost double.

Those are returns that are staring investors in the face, while there is far less clarity about what Anthropic's future might look like. Broadcom and Nvidia look well positioned to have huge years in 2027, and their shareholders don't face the types of risks that come with investing in a newly public company. As a result, I think Broadcom and Nvidia are the two best stocks to buy in the market in November, and investors shouldn't wait around too long to take advantage of their low prices, as they could start to soar as the market looks ahead to 2027.

news.Title: Marvell gives up a third of itself to buy its laser supplier
news.Content:
Last week, I described a fading rally in Lumentum Holdings ( LITE ) shares as the market marking down a takeover premium in real time. On Monday, November 2, 2026, Marvell Technology ( MRVL ) made it official. The markdown has gone further than the headline price suggests.

Marvell agreed to buy the laser maker in an all-stock deal valued at $115 billion, according to a press release . Lumentum holders will receive 4.5 Marvell shares for each share they own.

Marvell's current owners will hold about 67% of the combined company after closing, the companies said. In other words, Marvell is handing a third of itself to Lumentum's shareholders.

Also read: Marvell may buy its own laser supplier as investors pull back

That split is fixed. The dollar value Lumentum's holders will receive is not fixed, and Marvell's falling stock has reduced it.

Marvell's slide has already erased the deal premium

The press release values the offer at about $1,132 per Lumentum share. The price reflects a 23.9% premium, based on both stocks' closing prices on Wednesday, October 28, 2026, before deal talk began.

Marvell shares fell about 22% between the leak and the close on Friday, October 30, 2026, partly on a broad chip selloff, according to Reuters .

By my math, a Marvell decline of about 19% wipes out that premium. At Friday's close, 4.5 Marvell shares were worth roughly $884, below Lumentum's implied pre-leak price of about $914.

The premium was gone before the deal was announced. On deal day, Marvell shares fell about 10%, and Lumentum dropped about 15% in afternoon trading.

Lumentum falling harder than its buyer stands out. By my math, Lumentum's discount to the offer's value roughly doubled from Friday. To me, that gap is the market's price for waiting until 2028 and for the risk that regulators say no.

Marvell CEO Matt Murphy sees it differently. "Whether we're trading at $180 or $280," he told Fox Business , the agreed ownership split "is very, very compelling for Lumentum shareholders."

He said the split came from him and Lumentum CEO Michael Hurlston "haggling it out" until the terms were "high for me and too low for him."

Lumentum is growing faster than the company buying it

Lumentum's latest quarter suggests Hurlston had plenty to haggle with. He said in the same interview that the results, released three days early , had "gotten lost in the backwash."

Revenue jumped about 136% from a year earlier to $1.26 billion, according to Lumentum's earnings release . By comparison, Marvell's revenue grew 37% in its latest full quarter, according to its August earnings release . Lumentum is growing more than three times as fast.

Story Continues

More importantly, Hurlston said in the release that Lumentum secured its second major win in near-packaged and co-packaged optics. That win is "backed by purchase commitments exceeding $5 billion," he said.

Those designs put optics beside or inside the chip package. That commitment matters more than the earnings beat. It shows Marvell is buying contracted demand.

Marvell's promised savings come from the factory floor

That demand only rewards Marvell's owners if margins follow. The investor presentation puts the combined non-GAAP gross margin at 57%. Marvell's own is 58%, so the deal starts by diluting it.

The fix is more than $1 billion in yearly cost savings, mostly from cost of goods sold, according to the presentation. In plain terms, that means cheaper production.

By my math, those savings equal more than 5% of the presentation's $17.7 billion in combined annualized revenue. Savings of that size would lift the combined gross margin above Marvell's standalone level.

Yet that payoff waits on a closing expected in the first half of 2028, the press release said. Meanwhile, here is where last week's three questions stand:

The exchange ratio is settled, handing Lumentum holders about a third of the company.

Adjusted earnings of $4.57 per share beat the $4.22 analysts expected, according to Seeking Alpha .

Cloud Light, the Lumentum module unit that competes with some Marvell chip customers, goes unmentioned in Monday's press release and presentation.

Murphy's words sharpen that last risk. He said the combined company could go from "selling an individual component" to selling "an entire module."

He meant new scale-up designs, but many of Marvell's chip customers build modules. Last week, I wanted the terms before adding Marvell. Now that comment keeps me on the sidelines for both stocks.

More Marvell:

Marvell may buy its own laser supplier as investors pull back

Bank of America tweaks Marvell stock target after key Analyst Day

Marvell just made a move that changes the AI networking story

Marvell's deals keep moving deeper into optics

The bigger question is what kind of company Marvell becomes. The Lumentum deal is more than 10 times Marvell's previous biggest purchase, the $10 billion Inphi buyout in 2021, according to Reuters . Inphi made electro-optics products, according to a Marvell press release .

In February 2026, Marvell completed its purchase of Celestial AI, which it called "a pioneer in optical interconnect technology." Lumentum goes further, giving Marvell the lasers and the plants that make them.

However, paying in stock makes the buyer's share price the real price tag. "You take more risk when you do it," Murphy said. Marvell has more than a year to prove its shares are worth the third it is giving away.

news.Title: Apple makes money in an area where Amazon loses millions
news.Content:
When Amazon and Apple went into the television business, many saw the moves as a vanity play, a way for company executives to meet Hollywood royalty, not a smart business play.

"In its six-ish years of existence, Apple TV+ has mostly operated as a sort of vanity project, largely immune to such quotidian concerns as profit , revenue , and return on investment ," Puck reported.

The American Prospect's David Dayen was particularly harsh when judging Amazon's video efforts.

"Why does Amazon run a streaming video service? Why does it run a Hollywood movie studio? Businesses generally try to make money. We don't know that to be the case for Amazon's streaming, and its film and digital production, because film and television are not broken out as separate revenue streams," he wrote.

Both companies have been questioned about whether they're making television shows and movies to actually make money.

Apple has yet to answer that question, but Amazon CEO Andy Jassy was emphatic about his company's video efforts during its third-quarter earnings call .

Amazon Prime Video makes money

I'm a fan of Amazon Prime Video and watch multiple shows on the platform. I pay for Prime because it offers free two-day, and sometimes next-day, or even same-day shipping, but if Amazon asked for a separate subscription fee for its video service, I'd almost certainly pay it.

Amazon does not charge separately for its video service. Instead, it has leveraged Prime Video to make members more loyal.

That's a loss leader strategy, but the company has found ways to make Prime Video work as a business, not just a vanity project.

"Prime Video has emerged as a significant business with a revenue run rate in the tens of billions of dollars, now profitable in its own right. We have momentum with hit shows like 'Carrie,' 'The Summer I Turned Pretty,' 'The Boys,' 'Off Campus,' 'Reacher,' and 'Fallout.' Breakout movies like 'Project Hail Mary,' along with compelling live sports, including Thursday Night Football, off to its best start ever in 2026, NBA on Prime, NASCAR, the Masters, and UEFA Champions League soccer," Jassy said.

More Tech:

Meta and Microsoft just sent employees a memo about Anthropic

Microsoft cutting off popular software with no extension Oct. 13

Apple's biggest AI advantage may face new privacy challenge

Amazon does not break out Prime Video's financials or subscribers separately.

However, the service's ad tier reaches more than 315 million monthly active users globally, including more than 130 million in the United States alone, according to The Wrap .

Story Continues

Video users can pay a fee of $4.99 per month to upgrade to an ad-free experience.

Apple TV is not making money

Much like I would choose to pay extra for Prime Video, I do actually pay for Apple TV. It's $14.99 a month on its own, but I have bundled it with other Apple services, which brings the overall cost down slightly.

Apple TV does not offer the same volume of shows as Netflix or Prime, but it has prestige offerings, including "Severance," "Shrinking," and "Pluribus," that I have found worth the price.

The Apple TV+ premium subscription service is losing more than $1 billion per year, according to an anonymously sourced report by The Information.

"The tech giant is spending around $4.5 billion on content annually, down from $5 billion in past years, according to the article."

Apple TV+ — which features virtually an all-original lineup — has about 45 million subscribers.

The streaming service has worked to bring Apple positive attention.

"Apple TV+ spends less than any major competitor, wins more awards per dollar than all of them, and still loses over a billion dollars a year. That paradox is the most interesting business story in Hollywood right now," High on Films reported.

That's not the same as being a successful business.

"This is not an argument that Apple TV+ is well-run. It may not be. It is an argument that the numbers, laid out honestly, tell a stranger and more interesting story than the conventional narrative, which is simply that Apple built an expensive vanity project that nobody watches," the site added.

Related: Target has a problem that sends shoppers to Amazon

news.Title: AEIS Q3 Earnings Beat on Semiconductor and Data Center Strength
news.Content:
Advanced Energy Industries AEIS reported third-quarter 2026 non-GAAP earnings of $3.65 per share, up 109.8% year over year and beating the Zacks Consensus Estimate by 19.28%.

Revenues increased 50.3% year over year to $696.4 million, surpassing the consensus estimate by 7.74%. Results benefited from record Semiconductor Equipment and Data Center Computing sales, stronger customer demand and improved factory execution. Semiconductor Equipment revenues surged 63.9% year over year.

AEIS Sees Record Semiconductor Equipment Sales

Semiconductor Equipment revenues reached a record $322.2 million, increasing 15.8% sequentially and 64% year over year. Growth benefited from investments in leading-edge wafer manufacturing capacity, stronger demand for etch and deposition equipment, and expanding system power applications.

Advanced Energy secured several plasma power design wins for advanced-node processes and two additional wins in semiconductor testing. Management expects new plasma power products, including eVerest, eVoS and NavX, to begin contributing more meaningfully in 2027, supporting market share gains.

Advanced Energy Industries, Inc. Price, Consensus and EPS Surprise

Advanced Energy Industries, Inc. price-consensus-eps-surprise-chart | Advanced Energy Industries, Inc. Quote

The company expects more than 10% of its semiconductor revenues in 2027 to come from new products. Management also anticipates semiconductor growth to match or exceed wafer fabrication equipment market growth next year.

Advanced Energy Benefits From AI Infrastructure Demand

Data Center Computing revenues reached a record $256.2 million, increasing 33.8% sequentially and 49.3% year over year. Stronger hyperscale customer demand, new program ramps and improved factory execution supported growth.

Advanced Energy secured additional design wins among second-wave customers, including enterprise and neocloud operators. Management expects these programs to begin contributing incremental revenues in 2027, complementing continued hyperscale growth.

The company showcased its modular 800-volt power distribution board and liquid-cooled power technology at the OCP Global Summit. These solutions support evolving AI infrastructure power requirements. Management expects next-generation hyperscale programs, second-wave customers and 800-volt technology adoption to drive longer-term growth.

AEIS Reports Growth Across Industrial and Telecom Markets

Industrial & Medical revenues increased 13.1% sequentially and 27.1% year over year to $90.5 million. The business recorded its fourth consecutive quarter of year-over-year growth, benefiting from stronger demand and higher factory output.

Distribution resales continued to outpace sales into the channel. Advanced Energy also secured design wins in medical imaging, life sciences, test and measurement and aerospace and defense. Its newly launched Defiant Future power supplies expand opportunities in ruggedized applications.

Telecom & Networking revenues totaled $27.5 million, increasing 13.2% sequentially and 15.1% year over year. AI-related applications supported customer demand during the reported quarter.

Story Continues

Advanced Energy Expands Operating Margins

Third-quarter non-GAAP gross margin was 42.1%, expanding 300 basis points (bps) year over year and 20 bps sequentially. Excluding the second-quarter tariff-refund benefit, gross margin improved 140 bps sequentially, reflecting higher volumes and manufacturing efficiencies.

Non-GAAP operating expenses increased 19.3% year over year and 7.5% sequentially to $123.4 million. As a percentage of revenues, expenses declined to 17.7% from 22.3% a year ago.

Non-GAAP operating income reached a record $169.8 million. The non-GAAP operating margin expanded to 24.4% from 21.9% in the preceding quarter and 16.8% in the year-ago period, reflecting stronger operating leverage.

AEIS Strengthens Cash Position

As of Sept. 30, 2026, cash and cash equivalents were $1.42 billion compared with $1.40 billion as of June 30. Total debt stood at $1.27 billion, resulting in net cash of approximately $159 million.

Third-quarter operating cash flow from continuing operations was $66 million compared with $85.6 million in the preceding quarter.

Advanced Energy Raises 2026 Growth Outlook

For the fourth quarter of 2026, Advanced Energy expects revenues of $735 million, plus or minus $25 million. Non-GAAP earnings are projected to be $3.90 per share, plus or minus 30 cents.

Management expects non-GAAP gross margin between 42% and 42.5%, with operating expenses ranging from $126 million to $128 million.

The company raised its 2026 revenue growth outlook to approximately 40% from the previously projected low-to-mid-30% range. Second-half Semiconductor Equipment revenue growth is now expected to exceed 60% year over year, while full-year Data Center Computing growth is projected in the high-50% range.

Management expects robust revenue growth to continue in 2027, supported by customer investments, new products and expanding manufacturing capacity. It also maintains its longer-term gross margin target above 43%.

AEIS's Zacks Rank & Other Stocks to Consider

Advanced Energy currently sports a Zacks Rank #1 (Strong Buy).

Eaton近期同步推進擴產與併購，明確加大在電網設備與配電能力上的投入。公司規劃未來10年投入30億美元研發，並擬以9.23億美元收購COL Group，藉此補強歐洲配電能力與中壓產品布局。這項變化的重要性在於，Eaton不是只受惠於資料中心與電網升級需求，而是開始用資本配置把需求轉成更完整的供應能力。先前資料也顯示，公司電氣業務的積壓訂單持續增加，整體electrical backlog年增43%，其中Electrical Global backlog較去年同期超過翻倍，反映高壓開關設備、變壓器與配電保護設備需求仍在擴大。

DuPont de Nemours（DD.US）： 成交價152.23美元，上漲7.74%，開盤149.95美元，盤中高點154.67美元，盤中低點143.43美元，均價150.76美元，成交量16.97萬股。

DuPont先前已調整全年銷售預測區間，顯示管理層對全年營收的看法略有改善，但電子需求疲弱仍壓抑部分業務表現。公司先前公布第二季淨銷售30.94億美元，年減7%，其中中國銷售年減14%，並明確指出受電子業需求疲弱拖累。不過，公司仍把全年銷售預測由123億至125億美元上調至124.5億至125.5億美元，高於市場原先預期。值得留意的是，第三季經調整每股盈餘預測為0.84美元，低於市場預估，代表短期壓力尚未完全消退，營運主線仍是在需求偏弱環境中調整節奏，而非已全面重回強勁成長。

Flex（FLEX.US）： 成交價90.16美元，上漲7.08%，開盤86.4美元，盤中高點91美元，盤中低點86.19美元，均價89.55美元，成交量8.69萬股。

Flex近14日未見符合條件的公司新聞，現有資料也沒有顯示新客戶、新產能、重大訂單或財測更新等可直接改變營運判讀的事件。在缺乏公司專屬催化下，目前較難確認其近期變化是否來自基本面新進展。對後續追蹤而言，更關鍵的仍是管理層何時對製造服務接單、終端市場需求，或產品組合調整給出新說法。若沒有更具體公告，現階段仍不足以把短線走勢直接解讀為公司營運方向已出現明確轉折。

Vertiv（VRT.US）： 成交價238.92美元，上漲6.55%，開盤228.01美元，盤中高點239.64美元，盤中低點230美元，均價237.21美元，成交量30.76萬股。

Vertiv最新主線仍是把AI資料中心的供電與散熱需求，往更完整的基礎設施方案延伸。公司10月下旬公布第三季有機訂單成長超過100%，並揭露與NVIDIA合作的工廠預製方案，已導入挪威一座41MW的AI資料中心，且可擴充至100MW，代表其角色不再只是單點設備供應，而是更深入大型案場的整體建置。公司同時以Vertiv SmartIT整合機櫃、配電、液冷、監控與漏液偵測，顯示產品正朝系統化方案發展。另一項重要動作是收購Utility Innovation Group，交易對價最高可達26億美元，讓Vertiv把能力往電網互連與現場電源端延伸，企圖縮短資料中心從取得電力到實際上線的時程。

Applovin（APP.US）： 成交價242.99美元，上漲6.18%，開盤232.82美元，盤中高點244.18美元，盤中低點231.2美元，均價238.48美元，成交量11.89萬股。

AppLovin近來更明確地把成長重心集中在AI驅動的廣告平台，而非自有遊戲業務。資料顯示，公司已出售自有手遊業務，現階段核心產品是廣告推薦引擎AXON與廣告平台，並把服務從手機遊戲開發者延伸到電商品牌。這項轉變的重要性在於，公司營運模式更聚焦在高效率投放與變現技術，而非內容開發本身。近期主題資料也顯示，AXON持續處理跨遊戲廣告競價與投放決策，廣告主只需提供App、關鍵事件與目標，模型即自動決定受眾。同期調整後EBITDA利潤率已升至84%，高於2023年第三季的70%，反映平台化與演算法驅動的獲利能力仍在提升。

Moderna（MRNA.US）： 成交價231.97美元，上漲5.04%，開盤221.48美元，盤中高點235.5美元，盤中低點220.4美元，均價231.14美元，成交量52.86萬股。

Moderna已把mRNA平台從單一疫情產品，推向腫瘤與季節性疫苗的多產品線。最關鍵進展是與Merck合作的個人化mRNA癌症療法intismeran autogene，在高風險黑色素瘤第三期試驗中，讓復發或死亡風險較單用Keytruda降低42%，試驗共納入1137名已完全切除腫瘤的患者，兩年無復發率為82.2%，高於對照組的70.0%，且未見新的安全訊號。另一項已商業化的進展是mRNA流感疫苗mFlusiva已於8月5日獲FDA核准，其中50至64歲族群為完整核准，65歲以上為加速核准並需補做確認性試驗。這代表Moderna正把平台能力轉成可落地的癌症與疫苗產品，而不再只依賴新冠相關收入。

AMD（AMD.US）： 成交價493.23美元，上漲5.65%，開盤479.77美元，盤中高點497.4美元，盤中低點473.58美元，均價487.76美元，成交量112.45萬股。

Quanta Services（PWR.US）： 成交價653.14美元，上漲5.15%，開盤631.3美元，盤中高點654.59美元，盤中低點630美元，均價647.86美元，成交量5.95萬股。

Quanta Services最新變化是電網現代化需求已從題材走向更實際的執行階段。公司近7天財報後再度強化訂單能見度，總在手訂單升至637億美元，剩餘履約義務為418億美元，同期營收達120.1億美元，顯示輸電、變電站、配電網路與接電工程已持續轉成收入。這波需求不是單一公用事業專案，而是大型負載接入、再生能源併網與整體電網擴建同步推進的結果。先前資料已顯示，Quanta Services的積壓訂單和營收都處在高檔，如今新一季數字進一步證明工程量仍在擴大，也讓公司站在北美電力基礎建設升級週期的核心位置。

news.Title: MPWR Fell 15.9% in the Past Month. Is the Weakness a Buying Chance?
news.Content:
Monolithic Power Systems, Inc. MPWR has dropped 15.9% over the past four weeks even as operating momentum has strengthened. The pullback creates a clear investor tension between weaker share-price action and accelerating demand tied to artificial intelligence infrastructure.

The key question is whether the decline offers a better entry point or reflects risks that could keep pressure on the stock despite stronger earnings expectations and business growth.

Why MPWR's Past-Month Slide Matters

MPWR's four-week decline contrasts with a 6.3% gain over the past week, suggesting that near-term sentiment has improved without reversing the broader pullback. The stock's weakness has also come while the current-year earnings estimate has risen 3.9% over four weeks.

That divergence matters because it separates the price move from a clear deterioration in earnings expectations. Third-quarter revenues reached $1.20 billion, up 63.1% year over year, while non-GAAP earnings increased 73.2% to $8.19 per share.

AI Demand Still Supports MPWR's Growth Story

Enterprise Data remains the main growth engine. Third-quarter revenue from the segment reached $506.7 million, up 164.6% year over year and 33.2% sequentially, driven by higher sales of power-management solutions for AI and server applications.

Management also points to customer diversification, growing module adoption and higher content per computing platform. Analog Devices, Inc. ADI is likewise targeting high-density data-center power management, while Texas Instruments Incorporated TXN is developing 800-volt power architectures for next-generation AI data centers, underscoring the scale of the opportunity and competition.

Valuation Keeps Pressure on MPWR Expectations

The growth profile comes at a premium. MPWR trades at 36.21X forward 12-month earnings compared with 21.66X for its Zacks sub-industry, leaving limited room for disappointment if revenue growth, content gains or margin expansion slow.

The valuation also helps explain why a sharp share decline does not automatically make the stock inexpensive. Investors are still paying materially more than the peer benchmark for expected growth, so execution must remain strong to justify that premium.

MPWR Faces Mix, Margin and Inventory Risks

Enterprise Data accounted for 42.1% of third-quarter revenues, up from 38.8% in the preceding quarter. That mix increases MPWR's exposure to AI infrastructure spending even as the company broadens its customer base and adds new applications.

Other risks remain. Internal inventory rose to $764.9 million from $675.8 million sequentially, while management is absorbing part of rising supplier costs. Notebook demand has been softer, and Consumer revenues fell 11.6% year over year, showing that growth remains uneven across end markets.

Story Continues

MPWR's Bullish Signal Meets Weak Style Scores

The pullback looks more interesting because earnings-revision momentum remains favorable, but valuation and style-factor concerns keep the setup from being low risk. MPWR currently sports a Zacks Rank #1 (Strong Buy), a signal tied to positive near-term earnings estimate revisions. You can see the complete list of today's Zacks #1 Rank stocks here .

Zacks Style Scores are designed to complement the Zacks Rank, and weaker grades suggest the stock lacks the favorable value, growth and combined style characteristics typically associated with the strongest short-term setups. The decline may improve the entry point, but the premium valuation and operating risks argue for selectivity rather than treating the drop as an automatic buying signal.
